Its layered population and Malay-based local speech reflect centuries of contact across the seas linking Sulawesi, the Moluccas and the wider archipelago.
simp_chinese: 万鸦老面向海湾，背倚苏拉威西北部的群山。其名称原先指一座离岸岛屿，也就是今天的老万鸦老岛；聚落迁往大陆后，这个名称也随之转移。欧洲势力介入之前，当地向特尔纳特苏丹纳贡；后来葡萄牙与西班牙商人、军人在米纳哈萨社群之间争夺影响。1658年，荷兰东印度公司在此建造阿姆斯特丹堡，建立新的殖民据点。万鸦老也成为流放地：爪哇王子蒂博尼哥罗反抗荷兰的战争结束后，于1830年被送到这里。多层次的人口构成与以马来语为基础的地方语言，体现了数百年来苏拉威西、马鲁古与更广阔群岛之间的海上接触。

english: Manado Bay opens onto the seas of the Indonesian archipelago. The surrounding island world has long been joined by maritime trade and supports exceptionally varied tropical marine life.
simp_chinese: 万鸦老湾通向印度尼西亚群岛海域。周围的岛屿世界长期由海上贸易联系起来，并孕育着多样的热带海洋生物。

english: Managalang belongs to Sulawesi, the Indonesian island also known as Celebes. Its rugged central mountains historically kept its peninsulas relatively isolated from one another, often making sea travel easier than overland journeys.
simp_chinese: 马纳加朗属于印度尼西亚的苏拉威西岛，亦称西里伯斯岛。岛屿中央崎岖的山地在历史上使各半岛相对隔绝，海上交通往往比陆路往来更便利。

english: Manahoro belongs to the eastern Madagascar region. The wider island was settled by Austronesian arrivals during or before the middle of the first millennium AD, followed around the ninth century by Bantu groups crossing from East Africa.
simp_chinese: 马纳胡鲁属于马达加斯加东部地区。整个岛屿在公元一千纪中叶或更早已有南岛语族移民定居，约9世纪又有班图族群从东非渡海而来。

english: Manama is an old trading port on Bahrain in the Persian Gulf. Mentioned in Islamic texts by the fourteenth century, it passed under Portuguese control before the Safavids expelled the Portuguese in 1602.
simp_chinese: 麦纳麦是波斯湾巴林岛上的古老贸易港。14世纪伊斯兰文献已提及此地，后来由葡萄牙控制，直到萨法维王朝在1602年将葡萄牙人逐出。

english: Manambato belongs to the wider Androy country in southern Madagascar. This “spiny land” lies south of the Tropic of Capricorn between the Mandrare and Menarandra rivers.
simp_chinese: 马南巴图属于马达加斯加南部更广阔的安德罗伊地区。这片“多刺之地”位于南回归线以南，介于曼德拉雷河与梅纳兰德拉河之间。

english: Manan belongs to Kanem on the Sahelian frontier. The broader region stretches across Africa as a semiarid belt between desert and savanna.
simp_chinese: 马南属于萨赫勒边缘的加奈姆。更广区域以半干旱地带横跨非洲，位于沙漠与稀树草原之间。

english: Manangoora belongs to Australia’s Northern Territory. The wider northern country faces the Timor and Arafura seas and the Gulf of Carpentaria. Aboriginal occupation reaches deep into prehistory, while later Sulawesi traders visited northern shores seasonally to gather sea cucumbers for overseas markets.
simp_chinese: 马南古拉属于澳大利亚北领地。广阔北方地区面向帝汶海、阿拉弗拉海与卡奔塔利亚湾。原住民居住史可上溯至遥远史前时期，后来苏拉威西商人季节性造访北岸，采集海参供应海外市场。

english: The Mananjary estuary faces the Indian Ocean along Madagascar's eastern side. The island's maritime history brought together Austronesian settlers and later African migrants, producing a coastal world shaped by long-distance sea crossings.
simp_chinese: 马南扎里河口位于马达加斯加东侧，面向印度洋。该岛的海上历史汇集了南岛语族定居者及后来的非洲移民，远距离渡海塑造了沿岸社会。

english:
Near the meeting of the Negro and Solimões rivers, the country of the Manaós people became a strategic focus of Portuguese expansion into the Amazon. In 1669 the Portuguese established the Fort of São José da Barra do Rio Negro to strengthen their position against rival European powers. Built of stone and clay, with four cannons guarding its walls, the fort remained in service for more than a century. People who helped build it settled nearby, and missionaries erected a chapel dedicated to Our Lady of the Conception in 1695.

The rivers made Barra a valuable seat of government as well as a fortified settlement. In 1832 it received town status and the name Manaus, derived from the indigenous Manaós. The rubber wealth and monumental architecture associated with the later city belong chiefly to the late nineteenth century, well after the first fort had anchored Portuguese authority in this forested river junction.
simp_chinese:
在内格罗河与索利蒙伊斯河交汇处附近，马瑙斯人的土地成为葡萄牙向亚马孙扩张的重要据点。1669年，葡萄牙人建立圣若泽达巴拉杜里奥内格罗堡，以巩固其地位、抗衡其他欧洲势力。堡垒以石与黏土筑成，四门火炮守卫城墙，持续服役一百余年。参与建造的人们在附近定居，传教士又于1695年修建了献给圣母无玷始胎的礼拜堂。

河流使巴拉既是设防聚落，也是重要的行政驻地。1832年，它获授城镇地位，并采用源于原住民马瑙斯人的名称“马瑙斯”。后世城市闻名的橡胶财富与宏伟建筑，主要属于十九世纪后期；在那之前，最初的堡垒已在这片森林河流交汇地巩固了葡萄牙的权力。

english: Manapakuaniskau belongs to the Minganie country of Quebec. The wider province adjoins Labrador in the northeast and reaches coastal waters towards Nunavut.
simp_chinese: 马纳帕库阿尼斯考属于魁北克的明加尼地区。更广阔的省域东北毗邻拉布拉多，并延伸至朝向努纳武特的沿海水域。

english: Deep among the mountains of New Zealand's South Island, Manapouri branches into four long arms and contains thirty-three islands. Earlier Māori names are believed to have included Roto-ua, the rainy lake, and Moturau, referring to its many islands. Māori visitors found eels in the water and pigeons and kākā in the surrounding forests. A tradition tells of two sisters whose tears formed the lake, associating its later name with sorrow. The Waiau brings water south from Lake Te Anau and naturally leaves from Manapouri's southeastern end. Glacial excavation made the basin exceptionally deep, with its floor far below sea level, while wooded islands and mountain slopes divide the broad surface into sheltered reaches.
simp_chinese: 马纳普里湖深藏于新西兰南岛群山之间，分出四条狭长湖臂，散布着三十三座岛屿。它早期的毛利语名称据认为包括意为“多雨之湖”的 Roto-ua，以及指其众多岛屿的 Moturau。毛利人在湖中捕取鳗鱼，也在周围森林中获取鸽子与卡卡鹦鹉。一则传统故事讲述两姊妹的眼泪化作湖水，将后来的湖名与悲伤联系起来。怀奥河从北面的蒂阿瑙湖带来水流，并天然从马纳普里湖东南端流出。冰川挖蚀形成极深的湖盆，湖底远低于海平面；林木覆盖的岛屿与山坡，则将宽阔湖面分隔成一处处受庇护的水域。

english: Manarivo Bay lies on Madagascar’s Indian Ocean coast. The island’s settlement brought together Austronesian voyagers from the direction of present-day Indonesia and later Bantu migrants crossing from East Africa, contributing to its distinctive Malagasy cultures.
simp_chinese: 马纳里沃湾位于马达加斯加的印度洋海岸。岛上的定居历史汇合了来自今印度尼西亚方向的南岛航海者，以及后来从东非渡海而来的班图移民，共同参与塑造了独特的马达加斯加文化。

english: Manas lies on the western side of the Gurbantünggüt desert country. The Manas River formerly fed the saline lake bearing its name. South of the desert, glacier-fed streams descend from the Tian Shan to support a populated belt, contrasting with the dry interior of the Dzungarian Basin.
simp_chinese: 玛纳斯位于古尔班通古特沙漠地域西部。玛纳斯河过去曾注入同名咸水湖。沙漠以南，冰川融水河流从天山流下，滋养着有人居住的地带，与准噶尔盆地干旱腹地形成鲜明差别。

english: Manas Lake lies among the sands of the western Dzungarian Basin, a saline remnant of a much larger ancient lake. Geological movements diverted former tributaries and left separate basins, including Manas, Ailik and Alan Nur. The historical pattern of drainage was also different from that of today: in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries, the Manas River ran toward Alan Nur, accompanied by waters from the Hutubi and Santun rivers. The basin now called Manas Lake was fed chiefly from the northern rim of Dzungaria. Only in 1915 did the main Manas channel turn toward it, illustrating how shifting rivers could redraw the watery limits of this arid country.
simp_chinese: 玛纳斯湖位于准噶尔盆地西部的沙地中，是远古大湖留下的一片盐湖。地质运动使原有支流改道，留下玛纳斯湖、艾里克湖和艾兰诺尔等分离的湖盆。历史上的水系格局也与今日不同：18至19世纪，玛纳斯河流向艾兰诺尔，呼图壁河和三屯河的水也汇入其中。如今称作玛纳斯湖的湖盆，当时主要接受准噶尔北缘的来水。直到1915年，玛纳斯河主流才转向这里，显示出在这片干旱土地上，河道变迁如何重新划定水域的边界。

english: Manassas takes its later urban identity from a railway junction in northern Virginia. The name appears as Manassas Run on a land survey of 1737, although its origin remains disputed. A post office and railway stop were established in 1851 at the place then called Tudor Hall, and the Manassas Gap Railroad connected it westward towards the Shenandoah Valley. These developments belong to the nineteenth century, after the early modern era. During the American Civil War, the nearby battles of 1861 and 1862 made the name widely known; the junction itself had strategic lines towards Richmond, Washington and the valley. The postwar town was incorporated in 1873.
simp_chinese: 马纳萨斯后来的城市身份源于弗吉尼亚北部的一处铁路交汇点。1737年的土地测量中已出现“马纳萨斯溪”之名，但名称起源至今仍有争议。1851年，当时称为都铎庄园的地方建立了邮局和铁路车站，马纳萨斯峡口铁路又将这里向西连往谢南多厄河谷。这些发展发生于十九世纪，晚于近代早期。美国内战期间，附近于1861年和1862年发生的两场战役使马纳萨斯广为人知；铁路交汇点本身拥有通向里士满、华盛顿和河谷的重要线路。战后成长起来的城镇于1873年正式建制。

english: Manatara belongs to the Iowa country between the Mississippi and Missouri river systems. Across this wider region, early hunters adapted to a glacial landscape more than thirteen millennia ago. By the time European traders arrived, settled farming communities maintained complex economic and political networks.
simp_chinese: 马纳塔拉属于密西西比河与密苏里河水系之间的艾奥瓦地区。一万三千多年前，广阔地区内的早期猎人适应着冰川景观。欧洲商人到来时，定居农业社群已经维系着复杂的经济与政治网络。

english: Manaure Bay belongs to the wider Caribbean coast of South America. The broader Caribbean region combines mainland shores with the Antilles and many smaller islands and banks.
simp_chinese: 马瑙雷湾属于南美洲更广阔的加勒比沿岸。整个加勒比地区兼有大陆海岸、安的列斯群岛及众多较小岛屿和浅滩。

english: Manavgat lies between the wooded Taurus Mountains and the sandy Mediterranean shore of Pamphylia. Its river waters a fertile plain of grain fields, sesame and orchards before descending past the waterfall near the town. Higher mountain pastures traditionally drew Yörük nomads and their herds during summer, linking the coast to a seasonal upland world. The town's name preserves that of Byzantine Manava. Seljuk rule began in 1220, and the Ottomans took over in 1472. A fortress known as Zindan Kalesi, the Dungeon Castle, adds to a landscape whose ancient neighbours include the cities of Side and Selge.
simp_chinese: 马纳夫加特位于林木覆盖的托罗斯山脉与潘菲利亚的地中海沙岸之间。河流灌溉着种植谷物、芝麻和果树的肥沃平原，继而经过城镇附近的瀑布奔流而下。更高处的山间牧场传统上吸引约鲁克游牧民在夏季带着畜群迁来，将海岸与季节性的高地生活连接起来。城名保留着拜占庭时代马纳瓦之名。塞尔柱统治始于1220年，奥斯曼则于1472年接管此地。一座被称为津丹堡、意即地牢城堡的要塞，也点缀着这片以古城西代和塞尔盖为邻的土地。

english: The Solomon island waters enclose large islands and many smaller islets. Long-established Melanesian communities preceded the Spanish voyage of Mendaña, which reached the archipelago in 1568.
simp_chinese: 所罗门群岛水域环绕大型岛屿与众多小岛。长期定居的美拉尼西亚社群早于1568年抵达群岛的门达尼亚西班牙航行。

english: Manawatū belongs to the western North Island country of New Zealand. In the neighbouring Whanganui region, the river mouth supported substantial Māori settlement before European arrival, including the pā of Pūtiki.
simp_chinese: 马纳瓦图属于新西兰北岛西部地区。在邻近旺阿努伊地区，河口在欧洲人到来前已是重要毛利聚居区，包括普蒂基堡寨。

english: Manbij stands west of the Euphrates in northern Syria, where roads from inland Syria and Mesopotamia meet. In antiquity it was famed as Hierapolis, the holy city of the goddess Atargatis, whose sanctuary included a pool of sacred fish. The Seleucids made it a chief station on the road between Antioch and Seleucia on the Tigris. Harun al-Rashid restored the city in the late eighth century as a capital of the frontier province of al-Awasim. Nur al-Din later strengthened its fortress, and Saladin took it in 1175. The Mongol destruction of 1260 broke this long succession of urban and military importance, leaving extensive ruins visited by later travellers.
simp_chinese: 曼比季位于叙利亚北部、幼发拉底河以西，是叙利亚内陆与美索不达米亚道路的交汇处。古代这里以希拉波利斯之名闻名，是女神阿塔伽提斯的圣城，神庙内设有蓄养圣鱼的水池。塞琉古王朝将其作为安条克通往底格里斯河畔塞琉西亚道路上的主要驿站。8世纪末，哈伦·拉希德修复城镇，使之成为边疆省阿瓦西姆的首府。后来努尔丁加固了堡垒，萨拉丁则于1175年夺取此地。1260年的蒙古军破坏中断了它长久的城市与军事繁荣，留下大片遗址，供后世旅人凭吊。

english: Mancha Khiri lies in the southern part of Khon Kaen in northeastern Thailand. Its district reaches towards Chaiyaphum, and the town itself occupies part of the Kut Khao community.
simp_chinese: 曼差基里位于泰国东北部孔敬南部。其辖区延伸至猜也奔附近，城镇本身则占据库考社群的一部分。

english: Manchac belongs to the Konchuko highland country of the Andes. The broader Andean system comprises multiple ranges, high plateaus and intervening depressions along the western side of South America.
simp_chinese: 曼恰克属于安第斯的孔丘科高地地区。更广阔的安第斯山系沿南美西部展开，包括多列山脉、高原与其间洼地。

english: Manchan belongs to the northern Peruvian coastal world of Chimor. The Chimú kingdom arose around the tenth century and expanded along roughly a thousand kilometers of coastline before its conquest by the Inca around 1470.
simp_chinese: 曼昌属于秘鲁北部海岸的奇莫尔世界。奇穆王国约于十世纪兴起，势力沿约一千公里海岸扩展，直到约1470年被印加征服。

english: West of the Indus near Sehwan, Lake Manchar gathers streams descending from the Kirthar Mountains and exchanges water with the great river. Its shallow waters spread widely during the monsoon, and their seasonal movement has sustained both fishing and irrigation. The shores preserve a much older human presence: sites such as Lal Chatto, Mashak Lohri and Lakhiyo belong to the Harappan cultural world. The Mohana, often called the "Boat People", have made the lake their home and depended upon its fish. Mountain runoff, river floods and the lives of fishing communities thus meet within a basin whose boundaries change with the water.
simp_chinese: 曼查尔湖位于塞赫万附近、印度河以西，汇集基尔塔尔山脉流下的溪水，并与印度河交换水量。浅浅的湖水在季风雨季大幅铺展，季节性的涨落支撑着渔业与灌溉。湖岸还保存着更古老的人类活动痕迹：拉尔查托、马沙克洛里和拉基约等遗址属于哈拉帕文化。常被称为“船民”的莫哈纳人以湖泊为家，依靠湖鱼维持生活。山地径流、河流洪水和渔村生计，就这样汇集在这片边界随水量不断变化的湖盆之中。

english: Mancheng lies in the eastern foothills of the Taihang Mountains near Baoding. The area contains the Han tombs of Liu Sheng, Prince Jing of Zhongshan, and his wife Dou Wan.
simp_chinese: 满城位于保定附近的太行山东麓。当地保存着汉代中山靖王刘胜及其妻窦绾的墓葬。

english:
Manchester grew from the country around the Roman fort of Mamucium, near the meeting of the Medlock and Irwell. The medieval town later centred on the Irwell and Irk, remaining a manorial settlement whose market is recorded in 1282. Flemish weavers arrived around the fourteenth century, and woollen and linen manufacture helped the town expand. Thomas de la Warre founded its collegiate church in 1421.

Cotton gradually changed the scale of that older textile economy. The Bridgewater Canal opened in 1761, bringing Worsley coal into Manchester and cutting transport costs. Warehouses, merchants and mills transformed the town into a great market for Lancashire’s textiles. The Liverpool and Manchester Railway opened in 1830, joining this inland manufacturing centre to the port through which its growing commerce passed.
simp_chinese:
曼彻斯特从麦德洛克河与厄韦尔河交汇处附近罗马堡垒马穆基乌姆周围的地区发展而来。中世纪城镇的中心后来移至厄韦尔河与厄克河一带，仍是庄园聚落，其市场在1282年已有记载。约十四世纪，佛兰德织工来到当地，毛纺与亚麻纺织促进了城镇扩张。托马斯·德拉沃尔于1421年建立了当地的协同教堂。

棉花逐渐改变了这套古老纺织经济的规模。1761年开通的布里奇沃特运河将沃斯利煤炭运入曼彻斯特，降低运输成本。仓库、商人与工厂使城镇变成兰开夏纺织品的重要市场。1830年利物浦至曼彻斯特铁路通车，将这个内陆制造业中心与承接其日益增长贸易的港口相连。

english: Mandalgarh's hilltop fort stands in the contested country of Mewar, its ramparts and bastions enclosing a long crest above the surrounding land. Mahmud Khilji of Malwa took the place twice in the fifteenth century, beginning a succession of struggles that later drew in the Mughal emperors. Shah Jahan granted it to Raja Roop Singh of Kishangarh around 1650, but Rana Raj Singh recovered it in 1660. After further Mughal intervention, Rana Amar Singh retook it in 1706. In 1765 Mehta Agar Chand became its fort commander and repaired the walls and gates. His instructions also called for winning over inhabitants and cultivators through concessions, joining the work of fortification to the restoration of local allegiance.
simp_chinese: 曼达尔加尔的山顶堡垒位于屡遭争夺的梅瓦尔地区，城墙与棱堡围绕着高出四周地面的修长山脊。十五世纪，摩腊婆的马哈茂德·卡尔吉曾两度夺取这里，此后延续的争斗又将莫卧儿皇帝卷入其中。约1650年，沙贾汗将其授予基申加尔的鲁普·辛格王公，但拉纳拉杰·辛格于1660年收复该地。经历莫卧儿进一步干预后，拉纳阿马尔·辛格又于1706年将它夺回。1765年，梅赫塔·阿加尔·昌德出任守堡长官，修缮城墙与城门。他接到的指示还包括通过让利来争取居民和耕作者，使加固堡垒与恢复地方效忠同时推进。

english: Mandali belongs to the borderland associated with Hulwan between Mesopotamia and the Iranian uplands. The wider Hulwan district was known under the Sasanians, and its regional centre served briefly as a refuge for Yazdegerd III after the defeat at Qadisiyya.
simp_chinese: 曼达利属于美索不达米亚与伊朗高地之间、与胡勒万相联系的边地。广阔的胡勒万地区在萨珊时代已见记载，其区域中心曾在卡迪西亚战败后短暂庇护伊嗣俟三世。

english:
Mandandanji country extends across the Maranoa and Balonne river lands of Queensland, north of the place later known as Saint George. Its western reaches approached Bollon and Wallam Creek, and the later towns of Mitchell, Roma and Surat lie within its bounds. The Kogai formed a northern group around the headwaters of Coogoon Creek.

In the later era of colonial encroachment, the leader Bussamarai, also called Eaglehawk, combined diplomacy with organised resistance. He drew neighbouring peoples into a coalition and used carefully arranged spear formations against mounted opponents. Near Surat he also directed a large corroboree that dramatized cattle hunting and conflict with settlers, turning performance into a public account of the struggles over this country.
simp_chinese:
曼丹丹吉人的土地横跨昆士兰的马拉诺阿河与巴隆河地区，位于后来称作圣乔治的地方以北。其西部边界伸向博隆与沃勒姆溪，后来的米切尔、罗马和苏拉特诸镇都坐落在这片土地上。科盖人是其中的北方群体，居住在库贡溪源头附近。

到了殖民者侵入的较晚时代，领袖布萨马赖又名鹰隼，将外交活动与有组织的抵抗结合起来。他联合邻近族群，并以精心布置的投矛阵形对抗骑马的敌手。他还曾在苏拉特附近主持一场大型歌舞表演，演绎猎取牛群及与殖民者交战的情景，以公开演出讲述围绕这片土地发生的斗争。

english: The eastern Indonesian seas border the Maluku island world. These islands occupy a geographical and cultural meeting place between Asia and Melanesia.
simp_chinese: 印度尼西亚东部海域濒临马鲁古群岛世界。诸岛位于亚洲与美拉尼西亚的地理和文化交汇处。

english: Mandar Parvat rises above Bounsi south of Bhagalpur, a modest hill with a large place in the sacred geography of Bihar. An inscription of the Later Gupta king Adityasena, dating to the seventh century, records the construction of a temple here. Hindu tradition associates the hill with Mount Mandara, used by the gods and demons to churn the ocean for the nectar of immortality. Jains revere it in connection with the initiation, perfect knowledge and liberation of Vasupujya, the twelfth tirthankara. Beside the hill lies the Paapharni pond, with a temple to Vishnu and Lakshmi in its waters, while sculptures around the slopes testify to a long history of devotion shared by different religious communities.
simp_chinese: 曼荼罗山耸立于博恩西附近、帕格尔布尔以南，山体虽不高，却在比哈尔的神圣地理中占据重要位置。后笈多王朝阿迭多犀那国王的一方七世纪铭文，记载了在此建庙之事。印度教传统将此山与曼荼罗神山相联系，诸神与阿修罗曾以它搅动乳海，求取不死甘露。耆那教徒则将这里同第十二位祖师伐苏补阇的出家、圆满知识与解脱联系起来。山旁的帕普哈尼池中建有毗湿奴与吉祥天女神庙，山坡周围的雕像则见证了不同宗教群体延续已久的信仰活动。

english: Mandaragirau belongs to the Pabir country around the Biu Plateau. Its Dagil ruling family shared traditions of descent with the dynasty of Biu, yet maintained a separate chiefly identity. Accounts recorded in the colonial period place the foundation of its independent line under Ali Sokar around the middle of the eighteenth century, although the early genealogies and their dates remain uncertain. An older chiefly settlement occupied a hill near Virahyel; later observers recorded ruined compounds there and the remains of an unfinished stone wall below. The chiefs bore the title Mai and appointed subordinate officers of their own. Kinship, military cooperation and rivalry with Biu were therefore woven together in the town’s political history.
simp_chinese: 曼达拉吉劳属于比乌高原周围的帕比尔地区。这里的达吉尔统治家族与比乌王朝共享祖先传说，同时维持独立的酋长身份。殖民时代记录下来的叙述，将阿里·索卡尔建立独立统治世系的时间放在十八世纪中叶前后，不过早期家谱及其年代仍有不确定之处。较早的酋长聚落位于维拉希耶尔附近山丘上，后来的观察者在那里记录了院落遗址及山下未完成石墙的残迹。当地酋长使用“迈”的头衔，也自行任命下属官员。因此，与比乌之间的亲缘、军事合作和竞争，共同构成这座城镇的政治历史。

english: Mandi lies on the Kangra side of the wider Punjab world. Punjab takes its name from its five rivers, along which ancient settlement and agriculture developed.
simp_chinese: 门迪位于广义旁遮普地区靠近坎格拉的一侧。旁遮普之名源于五条河流，古代聚落与农业沿这些河流发展。

english: Mandiana lies in eastern Guinea, within the Kankan region and the southern Manding country. The locality has notable gold reserves associated with the ancient Birimian rock formations, including sedimentary rocks that underlie the surrounding terrain. This mineral wealth gives a distinctive character to an otherwise inland town. In the modern administrative landscape, Mandiana serves as the capital of its namesake prefecture; the town and surrounding sub-prefecture together counted 25,791 inhabitants in 2014.
simp_chinese: 曼迪亚纳位于几内亚东部，属于康康地区和南曼丁地域。当地拥有可观的黄金储藏，与古老的比里米岩层有关，周围地表之下也分布着沉积岩。这份矿产财富使这座内陆城镇具有鲜明的地方特征。在现代行政区划中，曼迪亚纳是同名省份的首府；2014年，城镇与周边分区合计有25,791名居民。

english: Mandingring is a town in northern Cameroon. It also forms a commune within the region's modern system of local administration.
simp_chinese: 曼丁林是喀麦隆北部的一座城镇。在现代地方行政体系中，它也构成一个市镇。

english: Mandisobi belongs to the wider Iberá wetland country of northeastern Argentina. This landscape of marshes, lagoons and watercourses takes its Guaraní name from an expression meaning bright water.
simp_chinese: 曼迪索比属于阿根廷东北部更广阔的伊贝拉湿地。这片沼泽、潟湖与水道相间的景观，其瓜拉尼语名称意为明亮的水。

english: Mandritsara belongs to the mountainous north-central homeland of the Tsimihety in Madagascar. Their name means those who never cut their hair, an identity associated with independence from the Sakalava kingdom to the west.
simp_chinese: 曼德里察拉属于马达加斯加中北部多山的齐米赫蒂人故土。他们的族名意为从不剪发的人，这一身份与保持独立、不受西面的萨卡拉瓦王国控制相关。

english: Mandi-yu belongs to the Camanducaia country of southeastern Brazil. The wider modern municipality occupies the southernmost part of Minas Gerais. Part of its land lies within the Fernão Dias Environmental Protection Area, established in 1997 to protect the surrounding regional landscape.
simp_chinese: 曼迪尤属于巴西东南部的卡曼杜卡亚地区。更广阔的现代市域位于米纳斯吉拉斯州最南端，其部分土地处于1997年设立的费尔南迪亚斯环境保护区内，保护周边地区的自然景观。

english: Mandjar belongs to the wider southwestern Australian country. Its Mediterranean-climate landscape combines forests, woodlands and scrub with a broad coastal plain rising into weathered uplands.
simp_chinese: 曼贾尔属于澳大利亚西南部更广阔的地域。其地中海式气候景观兼有森林、疏林与灌丛，宽广沿海平原向风化高地抬升。

english: Mandla occupies a loop of the Narmada, whose waters protect the town on three sides and draw worshippers to its riverbank ghats. It belonged to the Gond kingdom of Garha-Mandla, which expanded across the Narmada valley and neighboring hills under Sangram Shah. Mandla became the royal capital in 1670, but rival claimants and outside intervention progressively diminished the kingdom. Maratha invasion in 1742 brought demands for tribute, and in 1781 the last Gond ruler was deposed. The Marathas strengthened the town with a wall across its exposed side; in 1818 British troops stormed the fort after its garrison refused to surrender.
simp_chinese: 门德拉坐落在讷尔默达河的一处河曲内，河水从三面护卫城镇，也吸引信众来到沿岸河阶礼拜。这里属于贡德人的加尔哈—门德拉王国，该国在桑格拉姆沙阿统治下向讷尔默达河谷与邻近山地扩张。1670年，门德拉成为王都，但王位争夺与外部干预逐渐削弱了王国。1742年的马拉塔入侵带来纳贡要求，1781年最后一位贡德统治者被废黜。马拉塔人在城镇未受河流保护的一侧修筑城墙；1818年，守军拒绝投降，英军遂强攻堡垒。

english: Mandleshwar stands on the Narmada a short distance east of Maheshwar, in the Nimar country. Tanks, temples and riverfront ghats reflect the sacred place of the river in Hindu life. Local tradition associates the eighth-century philosopher Maṇḍana Miśra with the town and places his debate with Shankara at Gupteshwar Mahadev. A long stairway descends to Ram Ghat at a narrow stretch of the river, where monsoon floods can rise far above the ordinary water level. In 1819 Mandleshwar became the headquarters of the Nimar Agency and a cantonment, adding a colonial administrative role to its older religious importance.
simp_chinese: 曼德莱什瓦尔坐落于尼马尔地区的讷尔默达河岸，距马赫什瓦尔以东不远。水池、寺庙与河畔阶台，体现了这条河在印度教生活中的神圣地位。地方传统将八世纪哲学家曼荼那·弥尸罗与城镇相联系，并称他在古普特什瓦尔大天神庙与商羯罗辩论。一道长阶梯通往河道狭窄处的罗摩河坛，季风时节的洪水会远高于平常水位。1819年，曼德莱什瓦尔成为尼马尔代办区总部和驻军地，在旧有宗教地位之外又增添了殖民行政职能。

english: Mandor belongs to western Borneo’s wider trading landscape. On this island Malay coastal settlements and Indigenous interior communities were linked by great rivers; British merchants traded with Sambas from the early seventeenth century, joining an older maritime commercial world.
simp_chinese: 东万律属于西婆罗洲广阔的贸易地域。岛上的马来沿岸聚落与内陆原住民社群通过大河相连；英国商人自十七世纪初与三发贸易，加入了更古老的海上商业世界。

english: Mandore was a seat of the Pratiharas of Mandavyapura as early as the sixth century. A Pratihara family continued to rule after the wider Gurjara-Pratihara empire fragmented, and later allied with the Rathore chief Rao Chunda against the Delhi Sultanate. Marriage brought Chunda the fort as a dowry, making Mandore the Rathores' capital. Its possession became entangled with the politics of Mewar: after Rao Ranmal's assassination in 1438, his son Rao Jodha fled, and recovered Mandore only in 1453. In 1459 Jodha shifted his capital to the newly founded Jodhpur. Mandore nevertheless retained a royal role as a cremation ground, marked by the cenotaphs of Marwar's rulers. The thick walls of its ruined fort and the temples and memorials of its gardens preserve the memory of a capital displaced rather than forgotten; the Hall of Heroes contains sixteen figures carved from a single rock.
simp_chinese: 早在6世纪，曼多尔就是曼达维亚普拉普拉蒂哈拉王朝的统治中心。更广大的瞿折罗—普拉蒂哈拉帝国瓦解后，一支普拉蒂哈拉家族仍在此统治，后来同拉索尔首领拉奥·琼达结盟，以对抗德里苏丹国。一场联姻让琼达得到作为嫁妆的堡垒，曼多尔遂成为拉索尔人的都城。它的归属随后卷入梅瓦尔的政治：1438年拉奥·兰马尔遇刺后，其子拉奥·焦达逃离，直到1453年才夺回曼多尔。1459年，焦达将都城迁至新建的焦特布尔。不过，曼多尔仍作为王室火葬之地保有地位，马尔瓦尔统治者的纪念亭遍布其间。堡垒废墟的厚墙以及园中的庙宇和纪念建筑，保存着一座迁都后仍未被遗忘的旧都记忆；英雄殿中有十六尊从同一块岩石雕出的形象。

english:
Mandsaur lies where Malwa meets Mewar and is identified with the ancient city of Dashapura. Inscriptions reveal the Aulikara dynasties that ruled from here. At nearby Sondani, the victory pillars of Yashodharman proclaim his triumph over Mihirakula, preserving royal claims to power in stone. Dashapura also appears in Kalidasa's Meghaduta, giving the city a place in the literary geography of India.

The town remained a meeting point of larger political struggles. In 1732 Maratha cavalry under Holkar forced Jai Singh II of Amber to make terms after fighting around Mandsaur, securing money and the right to collect chauth from twenty-eight districts in Malwa. In 1818 the town gave its name to the treaty with the Holkar ruler of Indore that ended his part in the Third Anglo-Maratha War. Ancient royal inscriptions and later treaties thus mark successive contests for the wealth and authority of Malwa.
simp_chinese:
门德索尔位于摩腊婆与梅瓦尔交界，被认作古代的达沙普拉。铭文揭示了以此为统治中心的奥利卡拉诸王朝。附近松达尼的耶输达摩胜利石柱宣称他击败了密希拉古拉，将王权主张保存于石刻之上。达沙普拉也见于迦梨陀娑的《云使》，因而在印度文学地理中占有一席之地。

城镇后来仍是更大政治冲突的交汇处。1732年，霍尔卡率领的马拉塔骑兵在门德索尔一带作战后，迫使安贝尔的杰伊·辛格二世议和，获得赔款以及在摩腊婆二十八个行政区征收乔特税的权利。1818年，印多尔的霍尔卡统治者在此缔结条约，结束其在第三次英马拉塔战争中的参战。古代王室铭文与后来的条约，标记了各时代对摩腊婆财富与权威的争夺。

english: Mandu belongs to the wider Malwa and Nimar setting of central India. Nimar includes southern Dhar and the Narmada and Tapti valleys, separated by part of the Satpura Range.
simp_chinese: 曼杜处于印度中部更广阔的摩腊婆与尼马尔地理背景中。尼马尔包括达尔南部及纳尔默达河、塔普蒂河谷，两谷之间隔着萨特普拉山脉的一部分。

english:
Mandurah lies where the waters of the Peel Inlet and Harvey Estuary reach the Indian Ocean, amid the dunes and wetlands of southwestern Australia. The Noongar name Mandjar means a meeting or trading place, preserving an older identity than the colonial town. Fish-rich waters and seasonal wetlands distinguish this shore from the sandy, poorly watered soils around it.

The colonial settlement belongs to the closing years of the early modern age. After arriving too late in 1829 to secure his original promised land grant, Thomas Peel struggled to establish Clarence near the Swan River and then brought its remaining settlers to Mandurah. A townsite was laid out in 1831, but growth was slow: the census of 1837 recorded only twelve settlers, probably in three households. The fishing village that followed was still far removed from the large coastal city of later centuries.
simp_chinese:
曼杜拉位于皮尔湾与哈维河口湾通往印度洋的出口，周围是澳大利亚西南部的沙丘和湿地。农加尔语地名Mandjar意为集会或交易之地，保存着比殖民城镇更早的地方身份。丰富的鱼类资源与季节性湿地，使这段海岸有别于周边保水能力较差的沙地。

殖民聚落建立于近代早期的末尾。托马斯·皮尔在1829年抵达时已错过领取最初获许土地的期限，他在天鹅河附近建立克拉伦斯的尝试陷入困境，随后把剩余移民带往曼杜拉。城址于1831年规划，发展却很缓慢：1837年人口普查仅记录十二名移民，可能属于三个家庭。此后形成的渔村，距离后来规模庞大的滨海城市仍然十分遥远。

english: Mané belongs to the wider Boussouma country of north-central Burkina Faso. The regional center, Boussouma, lies in Sanmatenga, within the broad Mossi lands of the Sahel.
simp_chinese: 马内属于布基纳法索中北部更广阔的布苏马地区。地区中心布苏马位于桑马滕加，处于萨赫勒广大的莫西地域之中。

english: Maneva belongs to the historical setting of Menabe, the southern Sakalava country of Madagascar. Menabe grew into a powerful kingdom under rulers such as Andriandahifotsy in the seventeenth century.
simp_chinese: 马内瓦处于马达加斯加南部萨卡拉瓦地区梅纳贝的历史背景之中。十七世纪，梅纳贝在安德里安达希福齐等统治者治下成长为强大的王国。

english: Manfalut lies on the western bank of the Nile in Upper Egypt, roughly three hundred and fifty kilometres south of Cairo. Its Coptic name, Manbalot, means a place of pelts or skins, preserving an older linguistic layer beneath the Arabic form of the town's name. Cotton is among the crops cultivated locally. The Nile-side community also gave its name to the Egyptian writer and poet Mustafa Lutfi al-Manfaluti, who was born here.
simp_chinese: 曼法卢特位于上埃及尼罗河西岸，距开罗以南约350公里。它的科普特语名称Manbalot意为毛皮或兽皮之地，在城镇的阿拉伯语名称之下保存着更早的语言层次。棉花是当地种植的作物之一。这处尼罗河畔社群也将自己的地名赋予了出生于此的埃及作家兼诗人穆斯塔法·卢特菲·曼法卢蒂。

english: Manfredonia faces the Adriatic beneath the southern slopes of Monte Gargano. Its history begins with nearby Sipontum, a Roman colony and port linked to the coastal road and routes inland towards Beneventum. Siponto later became a Norman county and archiepiscopal seat, but stagnant lagoon waters following the earthquake of 1223 helped make the old settlement unhealthy. King Manfred built a replacement town several kilometres north between 1256 and 1263. The Angevin conquerors attempted to call it New Sipontum, yet the founder’s name endured. Its castle, begun under the Hohenstaufen and completed by the Angevins, guarded a coast exposed to war. The town resisted a French attack in 1528, but Ottoman raiders sacked and burned it in 1620, carrying hundreds of inhabitants into slavery.
simp_chinese: 曼弗雷多尼亚面朝亚得里亚海，位于加尔加诺山南麓。它的历史始于邻近的西蓬图姆：这座罗马殖民城也是港口，连接沿海道路及通往贝内文图姆的内陆路线。西蓬托后来成为诺曼伯国与总主教驻地，但1223年地震之后，潟湖积水使旧聚落的环境日益有害健康。1256至1263年间，曼弗雷德国王在北面数公里外建起新城。安茹征服者试图将它改称新西蓬图姆，创建者的名字却留了下来。霍亨斯陶芬王朝开建、安茹王朝完成的城堡守护着饱受战火威胁的海岸。城市在1528年抵御了法国进攻，却于1620年遭奥斯曼袭击者洗劫焚烧，数百居民被掳为奴。

english: Mang Việt belongs to the northwestern Vietnamese country associated with Ngưu Hống. This medieval Black Tai polity centred on the Black River valleys, where Tai communities had settled long before the eleventh century.
simp_chinese: 芒越属于越南西北部与牛吼有关的地区。这一中世纪黑泰政权以黑河河谷为中心，泰语社群在十一世纪以前很久便已定居。

english: Mangaia rises from the southern Pacific as a volcanic interior enclosed by makatea, a high ring of ancient coral limestone. Water drains through underground passages, and the resulting caves served as refuges and burial places. Excavations at Tangatatau indicate settlement around the year 1000; stone tools also show connections with Rarotonga, Samoa and Raiatea. By the sixteenth century, settlement had shifted inland and inter-island exchange had greatly diminished. Political life centered on struggles among war leaders for the title mangaia, while the ariki acted as priests. James Cook arrived in 1777. Tahitian preachers left by John Williams in 1824 helped introduce Christianity, and the ending of warfare preserved much of the distribution of land and titles then in place. Beneath later changes, collective land tenure remained a distinctive feature of the island.
simp_chinese: 曼加伊亚从南太平洋海面升起，火山内陆被称为马卡泰阿的古珊瑚石灰岩高环所包围。水流经地下通道排出，由此形成的洞穴曾被用作避难与安葬之所。坦加塔陶的发掘显示，人们约于公元1000年定居；石器也表明这里与拉罗汤加、萨摩亚及赖阿特阿存在联系。到16世纪，聚落已迁向内陆，岛际交换大为减少。政治生活围绕战争领袖争夺“曼加伊亚”称号展开，阿里基则担任祭司。詹姆斯·库克于1777年抵达。约翰·威廉斯在1824年留下的塔希提传教者帮助引入基督教，战争的终止使当时许多土地与头衔的分配格局延续下来。历经后世变化，集体土地所有制仍是该岛鲜明的特点。

english: Mangala is the country of the Mangarla people of Western Australia, traditionally associated with the northwestern Great Sandy Desert. Their territory extended across desert plateau around the McLarty Hills towards Geegully Creek; their language belongs to the Marrngu branch of the Pama–Nyungan family.
simp_chinese: 曼加拉是西澳芒加拉人的土地，传统上与大沙沙漠西北部相联系。其领地横跨麦克拉蒂丘陵周围的沙漠高原，延伸至吉古利溪方向；当地语言属于帕马—恩永甘语系的马尔恩古支。

english:
Mangalore stands where the Netravati and Gurupura rivers form an estuary on the coast of Tulu Nadu. Its Tulu name, Kudla, means junction. The port connected the lands behind the Western Ghats with the Indian Ocean: Cosmas Indicopleustes listed it among the pepper markets of the sixth century, and the Tunisian Jewish merchant Abraham Ben Yiju lived here in the twelfth. Ibn Battuta visited in 1342, shortly before Vijayanagara established control over the region.

Rice joined pepper among the harbor's important cargoes. In 1506 Ludovico di Varthema described nearly sixty rice-laden ships ready to sail. Portuguese intervention, Keladi rule and the ambitions of Mysore subsequently made the port a contested prize. Hyder Ali took it in 1763, and Tipu Sultan recovered it from the British in 1783. The Treaty of Mangalore ended the Second Anglo-Mysore War in 1784; after Tipu's defeat in 1799, the city passed into lasting British control.
simp_chinese:
芒格洛尔位于图卢纳德海岸，内特拉瓦蒂河与古鲁普拉河在此汇成河口。它的图卢语名称库德拉，意为“交汇处”。港口将西高止山脉腹地与印度洋相连：6世纪的科斯马斯将它列为胡椒市场之一，12世纪的突尼斯犹太商人亚伯拉罕·本·伊朱也曾居住于此。伊本·白图泰于1342年来访，不久后，毗奢耶那伽罗便控制了这一地区。

稻米与胡椒同为港口的重要货物。1506年，卢多维科·迪·瓦尔特马曾描述近六十艘满载稻米、准备出航的船只。此后，葡萄牙的介入、克拉迪的统治以及迈索尔的雄心，使港口成为争夺对象。海德尔·阿里于1763年攻占此地，蒂普苏丹又于1783年从英国手中收复。1784年的《芒格洛尔条约》结束了第二次英迈战争；蒂普于1799年战败后，城镇转入长期的英国统治。

english: Mangapet is a village in the Mulugu region of Telangana. Its Shiva temple is distinguished by facing west, giving the settlement a specific place in the region's religious landscape.
simp_chinese: 曼加佩特是泰伦加纳穆卢古地区的一座村庄。当地湿婆神庙以朝向西方为特点，在区域宗教景观中占有一席之地。

english: The Mangarayi country extends along the middle and upper Roper River in Australia's Northern Territory, reaching towards Mount Lindsay. Descriptions of their traditional lands include country east of Mataranka and Maranboy, as well as Mount Emily, Elsey and Beswick, with a northeastern boundary near Mount Elsie. This is a territory identified with an Indigenous people and their language, rather than with a single town. Much later, in 1875, allegations that some Mangarayi had taken part in the killing of a telegraph worker were followed by a punitive expedition. Police and vigilantes killed many Mangarayi and members of other peoples along the Roper River.
simp_chinese: 曼加拉伊人的传统领地沿澳大利亚北领地罗珀河中上游展开，延伸至林赛山方向。有关其传统土地的记述包括马塔兰卡与马兰博伊以东地区，以及埃米莉山、埃尔西和贝斯威克，东北边界则在埃尔西山附近。这片地域以原住民群体及其语言为身份标志，并不对应某一座单独城镇。很久之后的1875年，一名电报工人遇害，部分曼加拉伊人被指牵涉其中，继而引发惩罚性远征。警察与自行组织的报复队伍沿罗珀河杀害了许多曼加拉伊人及其他原住民群体的成员。

english:
Mangareva rises as the largest island of the Gambier group, its long central ridge overlooking a broad reef-filled lagoon. Fish and shellfish from those reefs provided a richer foundation for island life than the waters around neighbouring islands without such shelter. Polynesian settlement preceded European arrival by many centuries, and exchange with the Pitcairn Islands is evidenced from around the year 1000.

The island's communities once sustained canoe trade through a heavily wooded landscape. Extensive clearance between the tenth and fifteenth centuries diminished those forests and damaged both the environment and the economy. Their culture also developed a distinctive counting system combining decimal practice with named units of ten, twenty, forty and eighty. When James Wilson arrived aboard the Duff in 1797, he encountered an island with its own long history and a monarchy that would survive well into the nineteenth century.
simp_chinese:
芒阿雷瓦是甘比尔群岛最大的岛屿，纵贯全岛的中央山脊俯瞰着宽广、遍布珊瑚礁的潟湖。礁区鱼类与贝类，为岛上生活提供了比邻近缺少珊瑚礁的岛屿更充裕的基础。波利尼西亚人的定居比欧洲人到来早了许多世纪；约公元1000年起，这里与皮特凯恩群岛之间便已有交换往来的证据。

岛上社群曾在林木繁茂的环境中维系独木舟贸易。十至十五世纪的大量砍伐，使森林缩减，环境与经济都受到损害。当地文化还发展出独特的计数方法，将十进计数习惯与十、二十、四十、八十等有专名的单位结合。1797年，詹姆斯·威尔逊乘“达夫”号到来时，面对的是一座拥有漫长自身历史的岛屿，其王权还会延续至十九世纪深处。

english: The Papakena waters surround the Tuamotu atoll also called Tureia. Its lagoon has no navigable entrance, while a long strip of land covers the eastern reef.
simp_chinese: 帕帕凯纳水域环绕又称图雷亚的土阿莫土环礁。潟湖没有可供航船进入的通道，狭长陆地覆盖东部礁环。

english: The Tuamotu waters surround coral atolls such as Tureia, also known as Papakena. Its lagoon lacks a navigable entrance, and a long strip of land occupies the eastern reef.
simp_chinese: 土阿莫土海域环绕着图雷亚等珊瑚环礁，图雷亚也称帕帕凯纳。它的潟湖没有可供船只通行的入口，东侧礁盘上分布着狭长陆地。

english: The Tuamotu atoll of Tureia is also known as Papakena. Its lagoon has no navigable entrance, and coconut cultivation occupies much of the usable land.
simp_chinese: 土阿莫土的图雷亚环礁也称帕帕凯纳。潟湖没有可通航入口，大部分可用土地种植椰子。

english: The Papakena coastal waters surround Tureia, an atoll in the Tuamotu Archipelago. Its lagoon has no navigable entrance, while a long island covers the eastern reef; Hakamaru, near the northern tip, is its only village.
simp_chinese: 帕帕凯纳沿海水域环绕着土阿莫土群岛的图雷亚环礁。潟湖没有可供船舶通行的入口，一座长岛覆盖了东侧礁缘；北端附近的哈卡马鲁是岛上唯一村落。

english:
Mangarin is an old coastal settlement in southern Mindoro, now within San Jose in Occidental Mindoro. Chinese traders were anchoring off its shores in the fourteenth century, placing the settlement within the maritime exchanges of the Philippine islands. The surrounding southern coast faces the Mindoro Strait, while the nearby islands of Ilin and Ambulong belong to the same coastal world.

The region's human history extends much further back than these trading contacts: caves and rock shelters on Ilin preserve evidence of habitation roughly six thousand years old. The modern municipal name San Jose is considerably later, becoming the seat of civil government in 1910. Mangarin's older identity therefore preserves a distinct chapter of Mindoro's settlement and seaborne trade.
simp_chinese:
芒阿林是民都洛岛南部的古老沿海聚落，如今属于西民都洛省圣何塞。14世纪，中国商人已在其岸外停泊，使聚落成为菲律宾群岛海上交流的一环。周围南部海岸面向民都洛海峡，附近的伊林岛与安布隆岛也属于同一片沿海地理环境。

这一区域的人类历史远早于上述贸易联系：伊林岛的洞穴与岩棚保存了约六千年前的居住证据。现代的圣何塞市镇名称则晚得多，该地于1910年成为民政中心。因此，芒阿林更古老的身份保存了民都洛聚落发展与海上贸易中独立的一章。

english: Mangazeya first named a region around the Taz River, reached by Pomor traders before a Russian town was founded there in 1601 on the orders of Boris Godunov. Its wooden kremlin, rebuilt with five towers in 1607, guarded a market gathering furs and walrus ivory for shipment during the short northern summer. Indigenous tribute in furs, or yasak, also passed through the settlement. Fear of foreign penetration led the government to ban the sea route in 1619, directing traffic instead through the Irtysh and Ob. Depleted fur resources, changing routes and further restrictions weakened the town. In 1672 its Russian inhabitants were transferred to New Mangazeya on the Yenisei. The old site later yielded ship timbers that helped scholars reconstruct the koch, the vessel used in Arctic navigation.
simp_chinese: 曼加泽亚最初指塔兹河周边地区，波莫尔商人先于城镇到来；1601年，俄国奉鲍里斯·戈东诺夫之命在此建镇。木制堡城于1607年改建为五塔格局，守卫着汇集毛皮与海象牙的市场，货物趁短暂的北方夏季向外运送。原住民缴纳的毛皮贡赋亚萨克也经由这里集中。政府担心外国势力渗入，于1619年封禁海路，转而将交通导向额尔齐斯河与鄂毕河。毛皮资源耗竭、商路转移及进一步限制逐渐削弱了城镇。1672年，俄国居民被迁往叶尼塞河上的新曼加泽亚。旧址后来出土的船体木料，为学者复原用于北极航行的科奇船提供了重要材料。

english: Mangbu belongs to the Zhenxiong country of northeastern Yunnan. The wider county meets Sichuan and Guizhou near a three-province junction. Along its eastern margin, the Chishui River separates it from Sichuan’s Xuyong country.
simp_chinese: 茫部属于云南东北镇雄地区。广义县域在三省交接附近与四川、贵州相邻。赤水河沿其东缘流过，将其与四川叙永地区分开。

english: Mangge belongs to Kham, one of the three traditional Tibetan regions. Its wider setting combines wooded country and grass plains with river valleys that supported independent Tibetan polities and Buddhist monastic centres.
simp_chinese: 芒康属于藏地三大传统地区之一的康区。其广阔环境兼有林地、草原与河谷，孕育了独立的藏族政权和佛教寺院中心。

english: These uplands belong to the Htamanthi region of northern Myanmar. The wider forested country between the Chindwin and Uyu rivers supports elephants, gaur, serow and several large cat species.
simp_chinese: 这片高地属于缅甸北部的赫塔曼蒂地区。钦敦江与乌尤河之间更广阔的林区，栖息着象、白肢野牛、鬣羚和多种大型猫科动物。

english: The Mangin Range belongs to the wider upper Chindwin country of northwestern Burma. At nearby Tamanthi, gardens were established around 1700, and the village became associated with the production of pickled tea.
simp_chinese: 曼金山脉属于缅甸西北部更广阔的钦敦江上游地区。附近的达曼蒂约在1700年开辟园圃，并以制作腌茶而见于记载。

english: Manglares Cape projects from Colombia’s Pacific mainland near the Mira River. It lies in Nariño, southwest of Tumaco. The cape marks the westernmost extremity of the Colombian mainland.
simp_chinese: 曼格拉雷斯角从米拉河附近的哥伦比亚太平洋大陆海岸突出，位于纳里尼奥省图马科西南侧，标示着哥伦比亚大陆最西端。

english: Mangona became a fief of a branch of the Alberti family in 1140, with imperial confirmation following in 1164. The inheritance quarrel between Alessandro and Napoleone later found a place in Dante’s Inferno.
simp_chinese: 曼戈纳于1140年成为阿尔贝蒂家族一个支系的封地，1164年又获得皇帝确认。亚历山德罗与拿破仑兄弟之间的继承纷争，后来被但丁写入《地狱篇》。

english: Mangrol belongs to Hadoti in southeastern Rajasthan. The wider region takes its name from the Hada Rajputs and is crossed by the Chambal and its tributaries, whose alluvial soils support extensive agriculture.
simp_chinese: 门罗尔属于拉贾斯坦东南部的哈多蒂。广义地区得名于哈达拉杰普特人，昌巴尔河及其支流贯穿其间，冲积土壤支撑广泛农业。

english: Mangshi lies in western Yunnan and is the seat of Dehong Dai and Jingpo Autonomous Prefecture. Formerly called Luxi, the city is home to Han, Dai and Jingpo communities.
simp_chinese: 芒市位于云南西部，是德宏傣族景颇族自治州的州府。这里旧称潞西，生活着汉族、傣族和景颇族等群体。

english: Mangue Point lies in the northeastern Brazilian coastal sea. The wider North Brazil Current begins near ten degrees south as the South Equatorial Current divides against the continent. Warm water then travels northwest, linking this Atlantic margin with northern Brazil and the Guiana Current.
simp_chinese: 曼盖角位于巴西东北部沿岸海域。更大尺度上的北巴西海流在南纬十度附近形成，源于南赤道海流抵达大陆后的分流。暖水随后向西北流动，将这段大西洋海岸与巴西北部及圭亚那海流相连。

english: Mangueira Lake lies in southern Brazil near the Uruguayan frontier. This long lagoon extends for about 123 kilometres through the country of Santa Vitória do Palmar.
simp_chinese: 曼盖拉湖位于巴西南部，靠近乌拉圭边境。这座狭长潟湖在圣维多利亚杜帕尔马地区延伸约123公里。

english: Manguenzo belongs to the wider Lower Congo world of the Kongo peoples. Kikongo-speaking communities formed kingdoms including Kongo, Loango and Kakongo along central Africa's Atlantic side. Portuguese traders arrived in 1483, and conversion to Catholicism began among the Kongo in the late fifteenth century.
simp_chinese: 曼圭恩佐属于刚果人更广阔的下刚果世界。使用基刚果语的社群在中非大西洋一侧建立了刚果、卢安果与卡孔果等王国。葡萄牙商人于1483年到来，十五世纪末刚果人开始皈依天主教。

english: Manhuaçu lies among the foothills of eastern Minas Gerais in Brazil. Its local streams join the Manhuaçu River within the Doce River drainage basin.
simp_chinese: 马尼亚苏位于巴西米纳斯吉拉斯东部的山麓地带。当地溪流汇入马尼亚苏河，属于多西河水系。

english: Manhukdhitanwan belongs to the wider central Great Plains setting. Across this broad region, mixed-grass prairie forms a transition between taller eastern grasslands and shorter western prairie. Trees are sparse, and the grassland belt stretches across several river basins of the continental interior.
simp_chinese: 曼胡克丁坦万属于更广阔的中央大平原地区。整个区域的混合草原处于东部高草与西部短草之间的过渡地带，树木稀少，草原带跨越大陆内陆的多个河流流域。

english: Mani belongs to the Yucatecan Maya country associated with Mayapan. That regional centre served as a political and cultural capital from the thirteenth century into the fifteenth, enclosing thousands of structures within its walls.
simp_chinese: 马尼属于与玛雅潘相联系的尤卡坦玛雅地区。区域中心玛雅潘从十三世纪到十五世纪曾是政治文化首府，城墙内建有数千座建筑。

english: Mani Kikongo belongs to the wider Benguela country of western Angola. A historical kingdom recorded there in the sixteenth century occupied Umbundu-speaking highlands; around 1600, its territory was described as reaching from the headwaters of the Cuvo toward the Longa River.
simp_chinese: 马尼基刚果属于安哥拉西部广阔的姆贝格拉地区。十六世纪记载于此的历史王国占据使用翁本杜语的高地；约1600年，其领土被描述为从库沃河源头延伸向隆加河。

english: Mani Kinsomba belongs to the Wambu country within the wider Ovimbundu highland world. These central Angolan communities developed regional political groups such as Wambo and Bieno, supported by skilled agriculture and the raising of chickens, goats and pigs, with some cattle acquired from southern herders.
simp_chinese: 马尼金松巴属于广义奥温本杜高地世界中的万布地区。这些安哥拉中部社区发展出万布、比耶等地方政治群体，以成熟的农业和鸡、山羊、猪的饲养为基础，也从南方牧民处购入少量牛只。

english: The Mozambique Channel separates western Madagascar from the African mainland. Its warm southward flow joins the Agulhas system, carrying tropical water toward southern Africa.
simp_chinese: 莫桑比克海峡分隔马达加斯加西岸与非洲大陆。温暖南向水流汇入厄加勒斯系统，将热带海水带向非洲南部。

english: Manialtepec belongs to Oaxaca’s Pacific-facing southern Mexican setting. The wider region has preserved numerous Indigenous cultures, including Zapotec and Mixtec traditions, amid rugged terrain that helped communities retain distinct identities.
simp_chinese: 马尼亚尔特佩克属于墨西哥南部瓦哈卡面向太平洋的地域。广大地区保留着萨波特克、米斯特克等众多原住民文化，崎岖地形帮助社群维持各自身份。

english: Maniani belongs to Cuzcatlan, the pre-Columbian Nahua confederation of central and western El Salvador. The wider state stretched between the Paz and Lempa rivers, encompassing coastal lowlands and high country above two thousand metres. Its language, art and temples reflected ties with both Maya and Toltec traditions.
simp_chinese: 马尼亚尼属于前哥伦布时期萨尔瓦多中西部的纳瓦人联盟库斯卡特兰。更广阔的邦国位于帕斯河与伦帕河之间，涵盖沿海低地与海拔两千米以上的高地。其语言、艺术与神庙反映出同玛雅和托尔特克传统的联系。

english: Maniatique belongs to the Pelisipi country of eastern Tennessee. In the broader region, the Blue Ridge Mountains rise along the eastern border, forming some of eastern North America’s highest uplands.
simp_chinese: 马尼亚蒂克属于田纳西东部的佩莱西比地区。在更广阔的区域，蓝岭山脉沿东部边缘耸立，构成北美东部最高的部分高地。

english: Manica lies in the wider country represented by Angola’s Moxico region. The region is sparsely populated, with Luena as its provincial center and Zambia along its eastern borderlands.
simp_chinese: 马尼卡位于以安哥拉莫希科为地区背景的广阔地域。该地区人口稀疏，以卢埃纳为省域中心，东部边境邻接赞比亚。

english: Manicouagan belongs to the broad Quebec country of northeastern Canada. The wider region includes the former French colony of Canada, which passed to British rule after the Seven Years' War and retained a strong French-speaking culture.
simp_chinese: 马尼夸根属于加拿大东北部广阔的魁北克地区。更广阔的区域包括原法国殖民地加拿大，它在七年战争以后转归英国统治，并保留了鲜明的法语文化。

english: The Manicouagan Depression belongs to the wider Quebec landscape. This immense Canadian region neighbours Labrador and reaches northward to coastal waters adjoining Nunavut.
simp_chinese: 马尼夸根洼地属于更广阔的魁北克景观。这片广大的加拿大地区毗邻拉布拉多，向北延伸到与努纳武特相邻的沿海水域。

english: The Manicouagan Plateau belongs to Quebec’s northeastern Canadian setting. The wider province is Canada’s largest by area and reaches towards the Labrador frontier in the northeast.
simp_chinese: 马尼夸根高原属于加拿大东北部的魁北克地区。广义魁北克是加拿大面积最大的省份，东北延伸至拉布拉多边界。

english: Manigango stands on the Tro Chu east of the Chola Mountains in Kham. The township belongs to the Dege country and lies about ten kilometres north of the glacial lake Yihun Lhatso. Routes through it connect Derge in the west with Ganzi to the east.
simp_chinese: 马尼干戈位于康区雀儿山以东的朝曲河畔，属于德格地区，向南约十公里可达冰川湖玉隆拉措。途经此地的路线将西方德格与东方甘孜连接起来。

english: Manigotagan belongs to the Canadian Shield country east of Lake Winnipeg. Across the wider Atikaki region, streams and lakes drain westward toward Winnipeg through forested wilderness near the Ontario boundary.
simp_chinese: 马尼戈塔根属于温尼伯湖以东的加拿大地盾地区。在更广阔的阿蒂卡基地区，溪流与湖泊穿过安大略边界附近的森林荒野，向西排入温尼伯湖。

english: Manihi lies among the northern Tuamotu atolls, close to Ahe and within the island group later called the King George Islands. Its elongated lagoon is surrounded by a ring of small coral islands and opens to the sea through a single southern passage, Tairapa. Two old ceremonial platforms built from coral blocks preserve evidence of Polynesian religious life on the atoll. Jacob le Maire and Willem Schouten were the first Europeans recorded there during their Pacific voyage of 1615–1616, naming it Waterland Island. When John Byron arrived in June 1765 he applied another name, Prince of Wales Island, to the same inhabited coral world.
simp_chinese: 马尼希位于土阿莫土群岛北部，靠近阿赫环礁，属于后来被称为乔治王群岛的岛群。狭长潟湖由一圈珊瑚小岛环抱，仅通过南端的泰拉帕水道与外海相通。岛上两座以珊瑚石块砌成的古老祭祀台，保存着波利尼西亚宗教生活的遗迹。雅各布·勒梅尔与威廉·斯豪滕在1615至1616年的太平洋航行中来到这里，是有记录的最早欧洲来客，并将其命名为水地岛。1765年6月，约翰·拜伦抵达后，又为这同一片有人居住的珊瑚世界冠以威尔士亲王岛之名。

english: The Rangiroa region contains vast lagoons enclosed by low coral atolls. Rangiroa itself is the largest atoll in the Tuamotus, with Avatoru on its northwestern side.
simp_chinese: 伦吉拉地区拥有被低平珊瑚环礁包围的巨大潟湖。伦吉拉本身是土阿莫土最大的环礁，阿瓦托鲁位于西北侧。

english: Manihiki is a roughly triangular coral atoll in the northern Cook Islands, where some forty-three islets enclose a deep lagoon. Polynesian settlement is thought to reach back to about the tenth century. Its history is closely bound to nearby Rakahanga: the inhabitants formerly crossed between the two atolls every few years, drawing food from one while allowing the other to recover. On Rakahanga the community occupied a single village, but on Manihiki the groups settled separate islets under their own ariki. Local traditions explain the two atolls as land divided during a struggle between Huku and Māui. European vessels later bestowed several names, including Humphrey Island in 1822 and Great Ganges Island in 1828, yet Manihiki retained its indigenous name.
simp_chinese: 马尼希基是库克群岛北部一座近似三角形的珊瑚环礁，约四十三座小岛围绕着深潟湖。波利尼西亚人的定居被认为可追溯至10世纪左右。它的历史与附近拉卡杭阿环礁紧密相连：居民过去每隔数年就在两座环礁之间迁徙，利用一处的食物资源，同时让另一处恢复。在拉卡杭阿，社群共居一村；到了马尼希基，各群体则在自己的阿里基首领带领下，分住不同小岛。当地传统将两座环礁解释为胡库与毛伊争斗时分裂的土地。后来欧洲船只又赋予它多个名称，包括1822年的汉弗莱岛与1828年的大恒河岛，但马尼希基最终仍保留了原住民名称。

english: Manihiki is a remote coral atoll in the northern Cook Islands. Its roughly triangular reef surrounds a deep lagoon and carries about forty-three small islets.
simp_chinese: 马尼希基是库克群岛北部一座偏远的珊瑚环礁。大致呈三角形的礁缘环绕深潟湖，其上分布约四十三座小岛。

english: Manikandapuram served as a capital of Thekkumkur in the Malayalam-speaking country of the Malabar coast. Its Sreekrishna temple is attributed to King Eravi Manikanda Varman in the twelfth century. A local account explains the foundation as an act of atonement after the king accidentally killed a cow during a ritual hunt; the story belongs to the temple's sacred tradition. The Malayalam poem Unnuneeli Sandesam describes the settlement and shrine, together with passages said to connect Manikandapuram and Vennimala. Paddy lands recorded as temple property supported the feeding of large numbers of people, linking royal devotion to the cultivation and distribution of rice.
simp_chinese: 马尼坎达普拉姆曾是特库姆库尔王国的都城，位于马拉巴尔海岸使用马拉雅拉姆语的地区。当地的奎师那神庙据称由埃拉维·马尼坎达·瓦尔曼王于12世纪修建。地方传说将建庙解释为一种赎罪：国王在仪式狩猎中误杀母牛，因而兴建神庙；这一故事属于庙宇的神圣传统。马拉雅拉姆语诗作《Unnuneeli Sandesam》描写了聚落与神庙，也提到据说连接马尼坎达普拉姆和文尼马拉的通道。登记在神庙名下的稻田支撑着向众多人提供食物的活动，将王室崇敬与水稻的种植、分配联系在一起。

english: Manikdrug belongs to Telangana, the Telugu-speaking country of the Deccan. The wider region was historically linked to Hyderabad and later formed a separate Indian state in 2014; its name evokes the land of the Telugu people, alongside a substantial Urdu-speaking population.
simp_chinese: 马尼克德鲁格属于德干地区使用泰卢固语的特伦甘纳。整个大区历史上与海得拉巴相连，2014年另设为印度的一个邦；其名称意指泰卢固人的土地，当地也有相当数量的乌尔都语居民。

english: Manikpur belongs to Awadh, the historical country of northern India broadly corresponding to ancient Kosala. Under its eighteenth- and nineteenth-century nawabs, the wider region became a major centre of literary, artistic and architectural patronage.
simp_chinese: 马尼克普尔属于印度北部的历史阿瓦德地区，大体对应古代憍萨罗。十八至十九世纪纳瓦卜统治时期，整个地区成为文学、艺术与建筑赞助的重要中心。

english: Manila Bay opens into western Luzon through channels divided by Corregidor and Caballo, sheltering a broad natural harbour behind the Bataan peninsula. Its waters supported trade with neighbouring lands even before Spanish rule, while the Pasig linked the bay with Laguna de Bay inland. On its northern shores, the Pampanga River brings a great share of the freshwater that feeds the bay; mudflats and mangroves provided shellfish habitat and a natural buffer against storms. The anchorage at Mariveles and the shores of Cavite framed approaches to the harbour. In 1646, battles associated with La Naval de Manila marked the struggle against Dutch attempts to seize the Philippines, adding naval conflict to the long history of commerce across these waters.
simp_chinese: 马尼拉湾通过被科雷希多岛和卡瓦略岛分开的水道通向吕宋岛西面的海洋，在巴丹半岛后方形成宽阔的天然港湾。西班牙统治之前，这片水域已支撑着与邻近地区的贸易，帕西格河则将海湾与内陆的贝湖相连。北岸的邦板牙河为海湾带来大量淡水；滩涂和红树林既是贝类的栖息地，也能缓冲风暴。马里韦莱斯锚地与甲米地岸线扼住入港方向。1646年，与马尼拉海战相关的一系列战斗体现了抵御荷兰夺取菲律宾企图的斗争，在这片水域悠久的商贸史中，又添上了海军交锋的一页。

english: Manily belongs to the Penzhina country of northwestern Kamchatka. The wider district contains the Ichigem Range, the northwestern extremity of the Koryak Highlands. Rivers including the Penzhina, Belaya and Oklan drain a region inhabited by Koryak, Even and Chukchi communities.
simp_chinese: 马尼雷属于堪察加西北部品仁纳地域。广大地区包含科里亚克高地西北端的伊奇格姆山脉。品仁纳河、别拉亚河与奥克兰河等流经科里亚克、鄂温和楚科奇社群居住的土地。

english: Manipa Strait lies within the eastern Indonesian island world. Channels between islands formed links in regional trade as well as routes for the spread of religions and political influence.
simp_chinese: 马尼帕海峡位于印度尼西亚东部岛屿世界。岛间水道既是区域贸易纽带，也是宗教与政治影响传播的路线。

english: Manisa rises at the foot of Mount Sipylus above the fertile plain of the Gediz. Known in antiquity as Magnesia ad Sipylum, it stood near the battlefield where Rome defeated Antiochus III in 190 BC. Under the Empire of Nicaea it housed the imperial mint and treasury, and its surviving fortifications recall its importance before Constantinople was recovered in 1261. Saruhan Bey took the city in 1313, making it the centre of a Turkish principality. Under the Ottomans, Manisa became a school of government for princes: Mehmed II and Süleyman I were among the shahzades entrusted with its administration. This practice continued until 1595, when insecurity and a destructive earthquake marked a troubled turning point. Around 1700 the city remained known for cotton markets, locally named leather and caravans arriving from the east.
simp_chinese: 马尼萨倚靠西皮洛斯山麓，面向盖迪兹河肥沃的平原。古代称西皮洛斯山麓马格尼西亚，附近就是罗马在公元前190年击败安条克三世的战场。尼西亚帝国时期，皇家铸币厂与国库设在这里；残存的城防遗迹，仍显示着1261年收复君士坦丁堡之前它的重要地位。萨鲁汗贝伊于1313年攻取此城，使之成为一个突厥公国的中心。奥斯曼时期，马尼萨成为皇子学习治理的地方，穆罕默德二世与苏莱曼一世都曾在此担任地方长官。这一制度延续至1595年，当时的不安局势与毁灭性地震共同带来了艰难转折。约1700年，城市仍以棉花市场、以本城命名的皮革以及自东方到来的商队闻名。

english: Manistee belongs to the Michigan country of the Great Lakes. The wider region consists of two peninsulas, with a heavily forested Upper Peninsula and extensive shores on the surrounding lakes.
simp_chinese: 马尼斯蒂属于五大湖的密歇根地区。更广阔的区域由两个半岛组成，上半岛森林茂密，并在周围湖泊沿岸拥有漫长岸线。

english: The Manistique River reaches Lake Michigan along its northern shore, forming the natural harbour around which the later town developed. The town took the river's name, though a spelling error in its charter fixed 'Manistique' in place of the older 'Monistique'. Its municipal history belongs to the late nineteenth century: it was incorporated as a village in 1883 and as a city in 1901, after replacing Onota as the county seat. The harbour was subsequently improved with dredging, breakwaters, and a lighthouse. Behind the modern port remains the enduring geography of river mouth and great lake, with warm summers and cold winters marking a strong seasonal rhythm.
simp_chinese: 马尼斯蒂克河从密歇根湖北岸注入湖中，形成天然港湾，后来的城镇便围绕这里发展。城镇沿用河名，不过章程中的拼写错误将旧写法“Monistique”定成了今日的“Manistique”。其市政历史属于十九世纪后期：取代奥诺塔成为县治之后，它于1883年设村，1901年升格为市。此后，疏浚工程、防波堤与灯塔进一步改善了港湾。现代港口背后，河口与大湖交会的地理格局始终存在，温暖夏季和寒冷冬季带来鲜明的季节节律。

english: Manitoulin is the world’s largest island in a lake, set within Lake Huron and containing more than a hundred lakes of its own. Its name recalls an Indigenous tradition about a powerful spirit dwelling in an underwater cave.
simp_chinese: 马尼图林位于休伦湖中，是世界最大的湖中岛，岛上自身又有一百多个湖泊。其名称使人想起原住民关于强大神灵居于水下洞穴的传说。

english: Manitoulin Channel belongs to the northern waters of Lake Huron. The wider lake includes the North Channel and Georgian Bay, receives Lake Superior’s outflow through the St. Marys River, and drains south towards Lake Erie.
simp_chinese: 马尼图林水道属于休伦湖北部水域。更大的湖泊包括北水道与乔治亚湾，经圣玛丽河接纳苏必利尔湖来水，并向南流往伊利湖。

english: Manitowi Sakahikanihk belongs to the Manitou Lake country of the Great Plains. The lake occupies a closed saline basin fed chiefly by Eyehill Creek; its saltiness leaves it without fish, while nearby lakes and land form an important bird area.
simp_chinese: 马尼托维萨卡希卡尼克属于大平原的马尼图湖地区。湖泊位于封闭的咸水盆地，主要由艾希尔溪补给；高盐度使湖中没有鱼类，邻近湖泊与陆地则构成重要鸟区。

english: Manitowik belongs to the northern Great Lakes country around Baawitigong. The Ojibwe name means place of the rapids, referring to the St Marys River setting. Indigenous communities lived there long before French arrival in the seventeenth century.
simp_chinese: 马尼托维克属于巴维蒂贡周围大湖北部地区。其奥吉布瓦语名称意为急流之地，来自圣玛丽河环境。原住民社群早在17世纪法国人到来以前已居住当地。

english: Manitowoc belongs to Wisconsin’s Great Lakes country. The wider region ranges from northern forests and western unglaciated hills to wooded plains and the lowlands approaching Lake Michigan.
simp_chinese: 马尼托沃克属于威斯康星的五大湖地区。这片广大地域从北方森林、西部未受冰川侵蚀的丘陵，延伸至林间平原与密歇根湖附近低地。

english: Manjimup's name preserves Noongar words for an edible broad-leaved reed and the place where it grows. This country in southwestern Australia is associated with great karri forests, whose trees later supported a major timber industry. The modern town arose after the early modern period: timber cutter Thomas Muir took up land near its site in 1856, and it was formally declared a town in 1910. Railway access and later settlement schemes reshaped the landscape, though clearing the forest proved difficult for inexperienced farmers. Alongside this timber history came a very different distinction: John Cripps developed the Cripps Pink apple, marketed as Pink Lady, here in 1973.
simp_chinese: 曼吉马普的地名保留了努恩加尔语中一种可食用阔叶芦苇及其生长之地的含义。这片澳大利亚西南部土地以高大的卡里桉树林著称，后来形成了重要的木材产业。现代城镇的兴起晚于近代早期：伐木者托马斯·缪尔于1856年在今镇址附近取得土地，直到1910年才正式设镇。铁路与后来的移民安置计划改变了景观，但缺乏经验的农民发现，清理森林十分困难。木材业之外，当地还留下另一项独特成就：约翰·克里普斯于1973年在此培育出克里普斯粉红苹果，后来以“粉红佳人”之名行销。

english:
Manjung, long known as Dindings, occupies the southwestern coast of Perak and includes the waters and islands around Pangkor. Fishing communities on Pangkor’s eastern shore draw on the surrounding sea, especially for anchovies and squid. The remains of a Dutch fort at Teluk Gadong recall the contests between European strongholds, local Malays and sea raiders along this coast.

In the nineteenth century, Dindings became entangled in British intervention in Perak. The Pangkor agreement of 1874 accompanied a disputed succession and fighting over tin-mining districts, bringing a British Resident into the sultanate. Dindings later returned from colonial administration to Perak in 1935. The name Manjung was formally adopted only in 1973, much later than the older coastal communities.
simp_chinese:
曼绒长期以天定之名为人所知，位于霹雳西南海岸，包括邦咯周围的岛屿与水域。邦咯东岸的渔民依靠周边海域生活，尤其捕捞鳀鱼和鱿鱼。直落加东的荷兰堡遗址，见证着这段海岸上欧洲据点、当地马来人与海上劫掠者之间的争斗。

十九世纪，天定卷入英国对霹雳的干预。1874年的邦咯协定与王位继承争议及锡矿区争斗相伴，英国参政司由此进入苏丹国。天定后来于1935年从殖民行政管辖下归还霹雳。曼绒这一名称直到1973年才正式采用，远晚于当地旧有的海岸社群。

english: Mankera stands in the western Punjab, in a district where sandy ground and dependence on rainfall have long shaped agriculture. Its fortress is the town's defining monument: a brick stronghold built under Baloch rulers was later strengthened with a thick earthen enclosure under Pashtun rule. The fort also served as a prison for Humayun, son of Timur Shah, after his failed challenge to his brother Zaman Shah. In 1821, the forces of Ranjit Singh besieged Mankera. After twenty-two days Nawab Sarbaland surrendered, bringing the area under the Lahore state. The remains of the citadel and the nawab's tomb preserve the memory of this change of rule.
simp_chinese: 门盖拉位于旁遮普西部，当地的沙土地貌与对降雨的依赖长期塑造着农业生活。堡垒是城镇最鲜明的建筑：俾路支统治者修建的砖堡，后来在普什图人统治时期又增筑了厚重的夯土围墙。帖木儿沙之子胡马雍挑战兄弟扎曼沙失败后，也曾被终身囚禁在这里。1821年，兰季特·辛格的军队围攻门盖拉，二十二天后萨尔巴兰德纳瓦布投降，当地由此归入拉合尔政权。城堡遗迹与纳瓦布的陵墓仍保存着这次统治更替的记忆。

english: Mankessim is a traditional centre of the Fante on the Gold Coast, associated with the sacred grove of Nananom Pow and a market drawing traders from far afield. Fante oral traditions connect its foundation with migration from Techiman under three celebrated leaders, Oburumankoma, Odapagyan and Oson; some accounts give the older settlement of Kwaman priority. The migration cannot be dated securely, but historians generally place Akan settlement here before Portuguese traders reached the coast in the 1470s. English merchants of the eighteenth century knew the town as Murram. Its Asafo military companies formed another enduring part of local institutions, joining the authority of chiefs and the sacred landscape in the historical life of the Fante community.
simp_chinese: 曼克西姆是黄金海岸芳蒂人的传统中心，与纳纳诺姆波圣林及吸引远方商人的市场相联系。芳蒂口述传统将其建立与从泰奇曼出发的迁徙相连，传说中由奥布鲁曼科马、奥达帕吉安与奥松三位著名领袖引路；也有叙事认为夸曼聚落更早。迁徙年代无法确切判定，但历史学者通常认为，这里的阿肯人聚落早于1470年代葡萄牙商人抵达海岸。十八世纪英国商人把此镇称作穆拉姆。当地阿萨福军事会社也是延续已久的制度，与酋长权威和神圣景观一起，构成芳蒂共同体历史生活的重要部分。

english: Mankhamba was the capital of the Maravi Empire in present-day Malawi. Occupied from around the thirteenth century until the late eighteenth or early nineteenth, it headed a confederacy whose influence reached across much of southeastern Africa.
simp_chinese: 曼坎巴曾是今马拉维境内马拉维帝国的首都。聚落约从十三世纪延续至十八世纪末或十九世纪初，领导着影响力遍及非洲东南部大片地区的联盟。

english: Mankon is an old kingdom of Cameroon's northwestern grasslands, now within the wider Bamenda community. Its hereditary ruler, the fon, traditionally passes authority to a designated son born during the preceding reign.
simp_chinese: 曼孔是喀麦隆西北草原的一座古老王国，如今属于更广泛的巴门达社群。其世袭统治者称为丰，传统上由前任在位期间出生、并获指定的儿子继承权力。

english: Mankunda lies on the Mysore Plateau of southern Karnataka. The wider plateau is an undulating upland, generally 600 to 900 metres above sea level, bounded on its western and southern sides by the Western Ghats. Much of Karnataka's Kaveri River runs across it.
simp_chinese: 曼昆达位于卡纳塔克南部的迈索尔高原。更广阔的高原地势起伏，通常海拔六百至九百米，西侧与南侧以西高止山脉为界。卡纳塔克境内的卡韦里河很大一部分河段流经此地。

english: Too Naaleł Denh belongs to the wider Alaskan country of northwestern North America. Alaska faces the Pacific to the south and Arctic seas to the north, while the Bering Strait separates it from northeastern Asia.
simp_chinese: 曼利属于北美西北部更广阔的阿拉斯加地区。阿拉斯加南临太平洋、北接北冰洋诸海，白令海峡则将它与亚洲东北部分隔。

english: Manmaw belongs to the Shan highland country. The wider region consists of numerous peaks divided by narrow valleys and broader basins, with ranges linking northwestwards towards the Himalayan foothills.
simp_chinese: 曼茂属于掸邦高原地区。更广阔的区域由众多山峰构成，其间分布狭谷与较宽盆地，山脉向西北连接喜马拉雅山麓。

english: Mann lies in the Irish Sea between Britain and Ireland. Gaelic settlement helped shape its language and culture by the fifth century, while Norse rulers later made the island part of the Kingdom of the Isles alongside the Hebrides.
simp_chinese: 马恩岛位于不列颠与爱尔兰之间的爱尔兰海。5世纪时盖尔人的定居已影响其语言与文化，后来诺斯统治者把它与赫布里底群岛一同纳入群岛国。

english: Manna belongs to the Bengkulu country on Sumatra's southwestern coast. The wider region faced the Indian Ocean and contained small ethnically based kedatuan. It lay within the historical orbit of Srivijaya, while later great Javanese powers exercised comparatively limited influence here.
simp_chinese: 曼纳属于苏门答腊西南岸的明古鲁地区。更广阔区域面向印度洋，分布着依族群形成的小型kedatuan政体。这里曾处于室利佛逝的历史影响范围，后来的爪哇大国在此影响则相对有限。

english: The sea off Manna Point faces Sumatra within the Indonesian archipelago. The island's coastal communities joined trade networks linking South and East Asia, through which goods, religious practices and systems of learning circulated.
simp_chinese: 曼纳角外海面向印度尼西亚群岛中的苏门答腊。岛上沿岸社群参与连接南亚与东亚的贸易网络，货物、宗教实践和知识体系经由这些网络流通。

english: Manning Atoll belongs to the waters around the Solomon Islands and New Georgia Sound. The Manning Strait route links the Pacific to this long passage, which runs between Santa Isabel and Choiseul to the north and the New Georgia island chain to the south.
simp_chinese: 曼宁环礁属于所罗门群岛及新乔治亚海峡周边海域。曼宁海峡航路将太平洋与这条长水道相连；水道北侧为圣伊莎贝尔岛与舒瓦瑟尔岛，南侧为新乔治亚岛链。

english: Manning Strait belongs to the maritime landscape of the Solomon Islands. Their communities emerged from successive settlement waves, including Lapita migrants, long before Spanish navigator Mendaña arrived in 1568.
simp_chinese: 曼宁海峡属于所罗门群岛的海上地理景观。当地社群由包括拉皮塔移民在内的多次定居浪潮形成，远早于西班牙航海家门达尼亚在1568年抵达。

english: Mano belongs to the Upper Guinea country of West Africa. In its broad geographical sense, Upper Guinea includes Sierra Leone, Liberia and adjacent lands. The term also described the coastal region and related hinterland where Europeans traded from the sixteenth through nineteenth centuries.
simp_chinese: 马诺属于西非上几内亚地区。在广义地理概念中，上几内亚包括塞拉利昂、利比里亚及邻近土地。16至19世纪，该词也用于描述欧洲人开展贸易的海岸及其相联腹地。

english: Mano Iyo He belongs to the Great Plains, the western part of North America’s Interior Plains. The wider region encompasses extensive prairie, steppe and grasslands on the eastern side of the Rockies.
simp_chinese: 马诺伊约赫属于大平原，即北美内陆平原的西部。这片广大地区位于落基山东侧，包括广泛的草原、干草原与草地。

english: Amarsar is a village in Rajasthan’s Jaipur region. Local farming follows the seasons, with mustard, gram and wheat among winter crops and cotton and guar planted for the monsoon season.
simp_chinese: 阿马尔萨尔是拉贾斯坦斋浦尔地区的一座村庄。农业依季节展开，冬季作物包括芥菜籽、鹰嘴豆与小麦，季风季节则种植棉花及瓜尔豆。

english: Manoki belongs to the wider Mato Grosso region of central-western Brazil. Across this large region, broad plateaus and plains support Cerrado savanna, Amazon forest and the wetlands of the Pantanal.
simp_chinese: 马诺基属于巴西中西部更广阔的马托格罗索地区。在这片辽阔地域中，宽广台地与平原承载着塞拉多稀树草原、亚马孙森林和潘塔纳尔湿地。

english: Manomin belongs to the Red River country of the Great Plains. In the wider region, prairie and steppe cover much of the open land stretching eastward from the Rocky Mountains.
simp_chinese: 马诺明属于大平原上的红河地区。在更广阔的地区，从落基山脉向东延展的开阔土地很大一部分被草原与干草原覆盖。

english: Manoninerina belongs to Madagascar, the great island off southeastern Africa. Its long separation from Africa and India allowed plants and animals to evolve in isolation, producing an exceptionally distinctive natural world.
simp_chinese: 马诺尼内里纳属于非洲东南外海的大岛马达加斯加。它长期与非洲和印度分离，使动植物在相对孤立的环境中演化，形成极为独特的自然世界。

english: Manora belongs to the coastal setting of Sindh beside the Arabian Sea. The wider region is shaped by the alluvial plains of the Indus, the eastern Thar Desert and the western Kirthar Mountains; Arab conquest in 712 opened a new period in its history.
simp_chinese: 默诺拉属于阿拉伯海沿岸的信德地区。广义信德由印度河冲积平原、东部塔尔沙漠与西部基尔塔尔山地共同塑造；712年的阿拉伯征服开启了其历史的新阶段。

english: Manawan is an Atikamekw community on Lake Métabeskéga in Quebec. Its name refers to a place where eggs are gathered and derives from the nearby Manouane River. The form Manawan replaced the official spelling Manouane in 1991.
simp_chinese: 马纳万是魁北克梅塔贝斯凯加湖畔的阿蒂卡梅克社群。其名意为采集蛋的地方，来自附近的马努安河。1991年，官方拼写由Manouane改为Manawan。

english: Manouanis belongs to the broad Quebec country. The wider region was incorporated into New France, then became a British colony after the Seven Years' War.
simp_chinese: 马努阿尼斯属于广阔的魁北克地区。整个地区曾划入新法兰西，七年战争后成为英国殖民地。

english: The Manouanis massif belongs to the broad Quebec country. The wider region links the northeastern lands toward Labrador with central Canada, and later formed the historical core of French Canada.
simp_chinese: 马努阿尼斯山地属于广阔的魁北克地区。这一大区域连接东北方向通往拉布拉多的土地与加拿大中部，后来形成法属加拿大的历史核心。

english: Manra is a low, triangular atoll in the Phoenix Islands. Its land completely encloses a highly saline lagoon, with coconut palms, scrub forest and grasses growing around the water.
simp_chinese: 曼拉是菲尼克斯群岛中一座低平的三角形环礁。陆地完全围住高盐度潟湖，周围生长椰子树、灌木林和草本植物。

english: Rawaki belongs to the Phoenix island group in the central Pacific. Its treeless coral land surrounds a shallow lagoon isolated from the sea.
simp_chinese: 拉瓦基属于太平洋中部的菲尼克斯群岛。无树的珊瑚土地环绕着与海洋隔绝的浅潟湖。

english:
Manresa stands on the Cardener in the central Catalan country of Bages, its houses gathered around the basilica of Santa Maria de la Seu. Terraced vineyards formed an important part of the surrounding economy. In the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries, the town's Jewish community participated in manufacture, trade, lending and vine cultivation, before persecution and eventual expulsion transformed its life.

Ignatius of Loyola stayed here in 1522 after visiting Montserrat, spending time in prayer and solitude in a cave associated with the formation of his Spiritual Exercises. Another surviving window into local society is the Liber Manifesti of 1408, which distinguishes enslaved people from other servants and records their ownership and values. In 1808, Manresa's volunteer militia fought French troops at the Bruc pass; war also brought burning and destruction to the town.
simp_chinese:
曼雷萨坐落在加泰罗尼亚中部巴格斯地区的卡尔德内尔河畔，房屋环绕圣玛利亚大教堂分布。梯田葡萄园曾是周边经济的重要组成部分。十三至十四世纪，城中的犹太社群从事制造、贸易、放贷与葡萄种植，后来迫害和最终的驱逐改变了他们的生活。

依纳爵·罗耀拉在1522年探访蒙特塞拉特之后停留于此，在洞穴中祈祷独处；这一地点与其《神操》的形成紧密相关。1408年的《财产申报簿》则为当地社会留下另一扇窗口，区分奴隶与其他仆役，并记录其所有者和价格。1808年，曼雷萨的志愿民兵在布鲁克山口与法军作战，战争也给城镇带来焚烧与破坏。

english: Bahía Mansa is a bay and settlement on southern Chile’s Osorno coast. It is the principal harbor between Corral Bay and the Maullín River, with fishing supporting local life alongside later tourism.
simp_chinese: 曼萨湾是智利南部奥索尔诺海岸的一处海湾与聚落。它是科拉尔湾与毛林河之间的主要港口，渔业与后来的旅游业共同支撑当地生活。

english: Mansaka country extends through the river valleys and hills of southeastern Mindanao, including the Batoto, Manat and Hijo valleys and communities towards the Davao coast. The name is commonly explained as the first people to ascend the mountains or go upstream, joining man with saka. This river-oriented identity fits a homeland spanning both interior valleys and coastal settlements. In much later Philippine history, the Mansaka were included among the Indigenous peoples grouped under the collective name Lumad, adopted in 1986. That modern umbrella term embraces many distinct peoples and languages, while Mansaka preserves the particular name of this community.
simp_chinese: 曼萨卡人的土地延伸于棉兰老岛东南部的河谷与丘陵，包括巴托托河、马纳特河和希霍河谷，以及通向达沃海岸的聚落。族名通常解释为“最先上山或溯流而上的人”，由man与saka组成。这种围绕河流的身份认同，也符合其家园横跨内陆谷地与沿海聚落的分布。在菲律宾较晚近的历史中，曼萨卡人被列入1986年采用“卢马德”共同名称的原住民族群。这个现代统称涵盖许多不同民族和语言，而曼萨卡仍保留着这一社群自身的名称。

english: These Hudson Bay waters lie off the Ungava Peninsula around Mansel Island, also known as Pujjunaq. The island presents a low limestone coast, its gently rolling interior rising no higher than about one hundred metres. Covering more than three thousand square kilometres, it forms a substantial landmark off the peninsula. In 1613, Thomas Button gave the island its English name in honour of Sir Robert Mansell, a vice-admiral of the Royal Navy, linking this northern shoreline with the age of English exploration.
simp_chinese: 这片哈德孙湾水域位于昂加瓦半岛外，环绕因纽特语称为普朱纳克的曼塞尔岛。岛屿呈现低平的石灰岩海岸，内部地形缓缓起伏，海拔不超过约一百米。其面积超过三千平方公里，是半岛外一处显著的地理标志。1613年，托马斯·巴顿为纪念皇家海军中将罗伯特·曼塞尔爵士，赋予岛屿如今的英文名，将这段北方海岸与英国探险时代联系起来。

english: Mansila belongs to the western Sahel country associated with the Niger interior. The wider region forms a broad ecological boundary between the Sahara and Sudanian savannas, with a hot semi-arid climate.
simp_chinese: 曼西拉属于与尼日尔内陆相联系的萨赫勒西部地区。更广阔的区域构成撒哈拉与苏丹稀树草原之间宽阔的生态边界，气候炎热而半干旱。

english: Mansilla de las Mulas lies on the French Way of the Camino de Santiago in León. Its medieval bridge across the Esla provides a key crossing for pilgrims continuing towards León, tying the town to one of western Europe’s great pilgrimage routes.
simp_chinese: 曼西利亚位于莱昂的圣雅各之路法国之路上。埃斯拉河上的中世纪桥梁是朝圣者继续前往莱昂的重要渡河点，将城镇与西欧最重要的朝圣路线之一相连。

english: Mansinha belongs to the upper Tocantins setting within the Goiás plateau. This elevated country stands between several great Brazilian river basins, with waters draining south toward the Paraná, east toward the São Francisco and northward.
simp_chinese: 曼西尼亚属于戈亚斯高原的托坎廷斯河上游地域。这片高地位于巴西数条大河流域之间，水流分别向南通往巴拉那河、向东通往圣弗朗西斯科河，或向北流去。

english: The Manso country follows the Rio Grande near present-day Las Cruces and El Paso. Its people were semi-nomadic hunters and gatherers who practised little agriculture, living between farming communities. Spanish accounts first recorded them in 1583; some descendants remain around Tortugas Pueblo.
simp_chinese: 曼索人的地域沿着格兰德河展开，靠近今日拉斯克鲁塞斯与埃尔帕索。他们以半游居的狩猎采集生活为主，农业有限，居住在农耕社群之间。西班牙文献于一五八三年首次记载他们，部分后裔仍生活在托尔图加斯普韦布洛一带。

english: Mansoura stands on the eastern bank of the Nile's Damietta branch, in the heart of the Delta. The Ayyubid sultan al-Kamil established the city in 1219 on the site of older villages. Its name, "the victorious", became inseparable from the defeat of the Seventh Crusade in 1250. Louis IX was captured at Fariskur and held in Mansoura in the house of Ibrahim ibn Lokman, a secretary of the sultan. The imprisonment of a French king gave this riverside town a lasting place in the struggle over Egypt, while the house itself survived as a tangible reminder of that encounter.
simp_chinese: 曼苏拉位于尼罗河三角洲腹地、达米埃塔支流的东岸。阿尤布王朝苏丹卡米勒于1219年在若干旧村落的基础上建立此城。“曼苏拉”意为“胜利者”，这个名字与1250年第七次十字军东征的失败紧密相连。路易九世在法里斯库尔被俘后，被关押在曼苏拉苏丹秘书易卜拉欣·伊本·洛克曼的宅邸中。法国国王在此受囚，使这座河畔城市在围绕埃及展开的战争史中留下长久印记，那座房屋本身也保存下来，成为这段交锋的实物见证。

english: Mansouria belongs to Kabylia, the mountainous coastal homeland of the Kabyle people. This northern Algerian region forms part of the Tell Atlas along the Mediterranean.
simp_chinese: 曼苏里亚属于卡比利亚这一卡比尔人的沿海山地故土。阿尔及利亚北部的这片地区是地中海沿岸泰勒阿特拉斯山脉的一部分。

english: Mansura lies in Sindh, the country of the lower Indus. Its wider landscape combines riverine alluvial plains, the Thar Desert to the east and the Kirthar Mountains to the west; the region preserves major remains of the ancient Indus civilization.
simp_chinese: 曼苏拉位于印度河下游的信德地区。这里的广阔地貌包括沿河冲积平原、东面的塔尔沙漠与西面的基尔塔尔山脉；区域内保存着印度河古文明的重要遗存。

english: Manta has existed since pre-Columbian times as a trading place of the Manteño people. Its Pacific harbour later received the French scientific expedition led by La Condamine in 1735, before the party travelled inland towards Quito.
simp_chinese: 曼塔自前哥伦布时期便是曼特尼奥人的贸易地点。其太平洋港口后来于1735年迎来拉孔达明率领的法国科学考察队，队伍随后向内陆基多进发。

english: Mantago lies in the Canadian interior west of Hudson Bay, within the broader historical country of Keewatin. Established in 1876, Keewatin later became a Northwest Territories district; its name derives from Cree or Ojibwe words for the north wind.
simp_chinese: 曼塔戈位于哈德孙湾以西加拿大内陆，属于历史上广义的基韦廷地域。基韦廷于1876年设立，后来成为西北地区的行政区；名称源于克里语或奥吉布瓦语的“北风”。

english: The Mantaro jungle belongs to the river system of central Peru. Known in Quechua as Hatunmayu, or great river, the Mantaro links the Andean interior with waters ultimately feeding the Amazon.
simp_chinese: 曼塔罗丛林属于秘鲁中部的曼塔罗河水系。河流在克丘亚语中称哈通马尤，即大河，联系着安第斯内陆与最终滋养亚马孙的水流。

english: Mante belongs to the wider Tamaulipas country of northeastern Mexico. This region stretches toward the Gulf of Mexico and lies between the lands of Nuevo León, San Luis Potosí and Veracruz.
simp_chinese: 曼特属于墨西哥东北部更广阔的塔毛利帕斯地区。这一地区向墨西哥湾延伸，处在新莱昂、圣路易斯波托西和韦拉克鲁斯等地区之间。

english: Mantes stands on the Seine between Paris and Rouen, midway between the old centres of royal French and Norman ducal power. This position drew it into repeated struggles, and the town changed hands frequently during the Hundred Years’ War. Philip Augustus died here on 14 July 1223. The church of Notre-Dame, dating from the twelfth century, became its great landmark after the earlier church had been burned with the town by William the Conqueror in 1087. Under Louis XIV, Mantes gained another distinction as a centre for the manufacture of brass and woodwind instruments, a craft that outlasted the rivalries which had once made its river crossing so contested.
simp_chinese: 芒特坐落于巴黎与鲁昂之间的塞纳河畔，居于法国王权与诺曼底公爵旧日权力中心的中途。这一位置使它屡受争夺，百年战争期间城镇曾频繁易手。1223年7月14日，腓力·奥古斯都在此去世。建于12世纪的圣母教堂成为当地最显著的地标，其前身则在1087年与城镇一同被征服者威廉焚毁。路易十四统治时期，芒特又以铜管与木管乐器制造中心著称；这门技艺延续至后世，而早年围绕此处塞纳河渡越点的权力争夺已成为历史。

english: Mantiqueira lies within the broad Paraná region. Across this larger drainage, the Paraná carries waters south from Brazil toward Paraguay and Argentina; its name draws on Guarani words for river or sea, reflecting the immense waterway’s place in eastern South America.
simp_chinese: 曼蒂凯拉位于广阔的巴拉那地区。在这一更大的流域中，巴拉那河将巴西之水向南输送至巴拉圭与阿根廷；其名称源于瓜拉尼语中河流或海洋的词语，体现这条大河在南美东部的重要地位。

english: Manturovo is a town in the Kostroma country of Russia. Its name is also borne by several smaller Russian villages.
simp_chinese: 曼图罗沃是俄罗斯科斯特罗马地区的一座城镇。俄罗斯其他一些较小村庄也使用同一名称。

english: Manturovo belongs to the wider Kursk country of the Russian forest-steppe frontier. The regional town arose near the meeting of the Kur, Tuskar and Seym rivers. By the early eleventh century it was a stronghold of the Kievan princes along their southeastern border.
simp_chinese: 曼图罗沃属于罗斯森林草原边疆广义库尔斯克地区。地区城镇兴起于库尔河、图斯卡尔河与谢伊姆河相汇附近。11世纪初，它已是基辅诸侯东南边境据点。

english: Manuʻa comprises the volcanic islands of Taʻū, Ofu and Olosega in eastern Samoa. The islands rise steeply from the sea, with Taʻū reaching 931 metres. For centuries Manuʻa was the centre of the Tui Manuʻa political tradition, before regional power shifted toward western Samoa and the maritime influence of Tonga.
simp_chinese: 马努阿由萨摩亚东部的塔乌、奥富和奥洛塞加三座火山岛组成。群岛自海中陡然升起，塔乌岛最高达931米。数百年间，此地是图伊马努阿政治传统的中心，后来地区权力向萨摩亚西部和汤加的海上势力转移。

english: Manua’e belongs to the Society Islands country of eastern Polynesia. At the broader regional scale, settlement linked the Cook and Society groups with neighbouring archipelagos, while voyagers used wave and swell patterns to navigate between islands.
simp_chinese: 马努阿埃属于东波利尼西亚社会群岛地区。从更广的区域尺度看，移民活动将库克群岛、社会群岛与邻近群岛联系起来，航海者借助波浪和涌浪形态往返岛际。

english: Manuae belongs to the Polynesian island world of the Pacific. The name Polynesia describes a broad maritime region whose scattered islands have traditionally also been called the South Sea Islands.
simp_chinese: 马努阿埃属于太平洋的波利尼西亚群岛世界。波利尼西亚这一名称指广阔海洋区域，其散布的岛屿传统上也称南海诸岛。

english: The Manuae Coast belongs to the Polynesian waters of the Pacific. The wider region comprises more than a thousand scattered islands, whose Indigenous inhabitants share many linguistic relationships and traditional practices.
simp_chinese: 马努阿埃海岸属于太平洋的波利尼西亚海域。更广阔的地区由一千多座散布的岛屿组成，岛上的原住民在语言关系与传统习俗上有许多共同之处。

english: The Manuae coast belongs to the wider Polynesian island world. Across the central and southern Pacific, the peoples of this vast region share linguistic connections, customary practices and traditional beliefs.
simp_chinese: 马努阿埃海岸属于波利尼西亚岛屿地域。在广阔的中南太平洋，这一地区的各民族拥有语言联系、习俗与传统信仰上的共通之处。

english: Manuais belongs to the Gurguéia basin in northeastern Brazil. The river flows north from the Chapada das Mangabeiras to the Parnaíba. Cerrado savanna covers much of its basin, with dry Atlantic forest marking the transition toward Caatinga scrubland in the east.
simp_chinese: 马努艾斯属于巴西东北部古尔盖亚河流域。河流自曼加贝拉斯台地向北汇入巴纳伊巴河。塞拉多稀树草原覆盖大部分流域，东部的大西洋干林标示着向卡廷加灌丛的过渡。

english: Manubara belongs to New Guinea in the western part of Melanesia. This broader southwestern Pacific region extends eastward through the Solomon and Vanuatu island worlds toward Fiji.
simp_chinese: 马努巴拉属于美拉尼西亚西部的新几内亚。广阔的西南太平洋区域向东经过所罗门和瓦努阿图诸岛，延伸至斐济。

english: The Manues Jungle belongs to the Amazon basin’s immense tropical forest. Across the wider basin, a dense network of the Amazon and its tributaries supports extraordinary biodiversity. Indigenous communities of many languages and traditions have long relied on fishing and agriculture within this river-and-forest world.
simp_chinese: 马努埃斯丛林属于亚马孙流域广大的热带森林。在更广阔的流域内，亚马孙河与支流组成密集水网，支撑着极为丰富的生物多样性。众多语言和传统各异的原住民社群长期依靠这一河林世界中的捕鱼与农业生活。

english: Manuhangi’s coastal waters belong to the Tuamotu chain of the South Pacific. The wider island group consists mainly of coral islands and atolls, sharing a Polynesian cultural heritage and the Tuamotuan language.
simp_chinese: 马努汉吉沿岸水域属于南太平洋的土阿莫土岛链。整个群岛主要由珊瑚岛和环礁组成，共享波利尼西亚文化传统与土阿莫土语。

english: Manujan lies in the Kerman region of southern Iran. The older village obtained modern city status in 1996 and now serves as the centre of its surrounding county.
simp_chinese: 马努詹位于伊朗南部的克尔曼地区。原有村落于1996年取得现代城市地位，如今是周围县域的中心。

english: Manukau Harbour lies on the western side of New Zealand’s upper North Island. The neighbouring Waikato region spans the island from its west coast towards the Coromandel Peninsula in the east.
simp_chinese: 曼努考港湾位于新西兰北岛北部的西侧。邻近的怀卡托地区横跨岛屿，从西海岸延伸至东侧的科罗曼德半岛一带。

english: Manukau takes its name from the harbour of the same name near Auckland. The Māori words are commonly interpreted as “only birds”, and the name later served much larger administrative districts.
simp_chinese: 马努考得名于奥克兰附近的同名港湾。毛利语名称通常解释为“只有鸟”，后来也被用于范围更大的行政地区。

english: Manuri belongs to the South Australian region. The wider territory occupies the southern central part of the continent and contains some of Australia’s most arid landscapes.
simp_chinese: 马努里属于南澳大利亚地区。广义地区占据大陆中南部，包含澳大利亚最干旱的一些景观。

english: Manus belongs to the Bismarck island world of western Melanesia. At the wider regional scale, Melanesia forms a southwestern Pacific zone bordering Micronesia to the north, Polynesia to the east and Australia to the south.
simp_chinese: 马努斯属于美拉尼西亚西部的俾斯麦群岛世界。从更广阔的区域尺度看，美拉尼西亚构成西南太平洋地带，北邻密克罗尼西亚，东接波利尼西亚，南面是澳大利亚。

english:
Manyakheta stands beside the Kagina River in the northern Deccan, remembered as the imperial capital of the Rashtrakutas. Amoghavarsha I transferred his court here from Mayurkhandi, and the city flourished in the ninth and tenth centuries. After the Rashtrakutas fell, their Western Chalukya successors continued to use it as a capital until about 1050. Its wealth also drew attack: the Paramara ruler Siyaka sacked the city in 972–973.

Royal patronage made Manyakheta a major center of Jain learning. Jinasena and his pupil Gunabhadra composed the Mahapurana here, while Mahaviracharya wrote the mathematical Ganita Sara Sangraha. The Neminatha temple preserves pillars and walls from the ninth to eleventh centuries, along with a rich assemblage of sacred images. The later town of Malkhed thus inherits both the memory of an imperial court and the material legacy of a learned religious community.
simp_chinese:
曼耶凯达位于德干北部的卡吉纳河畔，因曾为罗湿陀罗拘陀王朝的帝都而闻名。阿莫伽伐沙一世将宫廷从马尤尔坎迪迁至此地，城市在九至十世纪繁荣发展。罗湿陀罗拘陀王朝衰亡后，继起的西遮娄其王朝仍将其作为都城，直至约1050年。财富也招来了进攻：帕拉马拉统治者西亚卡于972至973年间洗劫了这座城市。

王室赞助使曼耶凯达成为重要的耆那教学术中心。吉纳塞纳及其弟子古纳巴德拉在这里编成《大往世书》，摩诃毗罗阿阇梨则撰写了数学著作《计算精要集》。内米纳塔神庙保存着九至十一世纪的柱子和墙体，以及众多宗教造像。后来的马尔凯德镇，因而同时继承了帝国宫廷的记忆与学术宗教社群的实物遗产。
